chapters.title: Chapter 301: Peekaboo {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: If there were an award for the most hateful guy at this year’s auction, that award would undoubtedly go to Kent, the brat who was utterly detestable to everyone.
His tendency to jump into bidding wars only to end up buying items at overpriced rates was something everyone hated him for.
However, if there was something many hated more than Kent’s actions, it was the idea of compromise during a bidding war. There is no such thing as compromise in a bidding war.
The war exists to ensure that only the richest emerge victorious in the end.
So when the three blacksmiths came to an agreement to buy the skull for 12 billion, people were furious.
They wanted to see a good fight, but the three chose to end it before it could escalate into something fiercer.
That was something they couldn’t accept lying down.
But then, Kent jumped in, and everything turned chaotic.
The battle that was nearly over was suddenly reignited, this time by a brat who just didn’t know how to stay away from trouble.
This move, however, won him some fans, as smiles now replaced the frowns on everyone’s faces. The brat had jumped in, and the three blacksmiths would have to rethink their strategy.
"What do you two think? Should we band together and take this from him? With the three of us combined, there’s no way he can outbid us," Metal Saint Andrew said, clenching his fist.
His team of three Root Great Sages hadn’t returned when he sent them to retrieve the brat and the meteorite last night, so he was already furious with him.
"Let’s do that. With the three of us, he can’t challenge us," Metal Saint Rocky said, and Adolf seconded his words.
"22 billion," Metal Saint Andrew declared, now making it three against one.

"Gentlemen, I don’t want to sound rude, but even if there were ten of you, this skull will be mine. So, just a heads-up, give up now, and perhaps tomorrow I’ll let you have something good," Kent said.
"Cut it out, brat. Since you don’t know how to show respect to your seniors, then be prepared for a good fight," Metal Saint Rocky snapped.
"This isn’t about me being ungrateful. This is about me seeing value in something and buying it.
Also, this is an auction house, so instead of making it sound like I owe you a debt, why don’t you take my advice and drop out while you still can?
Of course, I don’t mind deciding for you. As a wise man once said, ’I can do this all day,’" Kent replied.
"30 billion," Kent announced, causing many to gasp.
"Like I said, I can do this all day. So ask yourselves, can you do the same?"
"Shut up, brat!"
"35 billion," Metal Saint Andrew shouted.
"45 billion," Kent said.
"50 billion," Metal Saint Andrew wasn’t backing down now. If this were just him, he would have backed down already.
But there were three of them, and like Kent, they all wanted the skull. They are blacksmiths, and this skill is like a treasure they cannot ignore.
So they want to buy and share. That way, they will each benefit.
The only downside here was that Kent would not share the skull with them simply because of what they did yesterday when he took the skull from him.
He needed it for something important, perhaps more important than what they needed it for, so they could not come to a compromise with him.
But even if they did, Kent wouldn’t form such an alliance with people who had tried to kill him and his ladies.
"Hmm, this is funny... but I like funny."
"60 billion," Kent raised the bid by ten billion, making it 60 billion, but the three blacksmiths still didn’t want to back down.
"65 billion."
"Well, I like to play, but I only play with ladies. So, since you seniors are big, bearded men, we can end the play here. I hope tomorrow you get lucky.
I really do, because I will be coming tomorrow too. And trust me, if I find something I want, I won’t hesitate to go all in from the start."
"100 billion," Kent raised the bid, and even Alina took a step back.
"Did he just bid 100 billion?" someone asked, trying to make sense of what had just happened. They might have heard wrong.
The bid was in the hundreds of billions, and from the look on everyone’s faces, it was clear that this wasn’t something they had expected on the second day of the auction.
It was only the second day. Damn it, why would the price rise to such a level so early?
The faces of the three blacksmiths turned ashen when they heard Kent’s bid. It was a hundred billion, and they didn’t have a budget for that—not when the heaven-shattering items were yet to be sold.
Did they really want to spend that much on the second day?

Tomorrow would be when all the powerful and influential would arrive. Did they really want to spend all their money today when tomorrow would bring a battle that could break friendships and shatter relationships?
"The gentleman in VIP room 13 bid 100 billion. Are there any more bids?" Alina asked, smiling. Her man had made her first-ever hosting of the annual auction a success.
This was something that filled her with joy.
She waited for a minute, but nobody threw in any more bids.
"The Metal-Skinned Storm Lion Skull is sold to the gentleman in VIP room 13 for 100 billion spirit stones."
Kent won the bid, and the greedy ones already started plotting again. They still haven’t learned their lessons.
The sudden turn of events took everyone aback.
But then Metal Saint Rocky spoke, and Kent’s reply wiped their minds immediately.
"Brat, are you sure it’s wise to anger us? The auction house can protect you while you are inside, but what happens when you are out of here?" he spoke in an angry tone.
Kent smiled, which turned into mocking laughter.
"Yesterday, after the auction, I had a few mice try to steal my fish. But when the day broke today, I had to dispose of those dead mice.
Though I wouldn’t advise you to send more mice, you can take it upon yourself and pay me a visit personally.
I promise you, tomorrow, you won’t be here bidding for any new items, for you won’t live long enough to tell the tale.
A wise man once said, ’When he is handsome and surrounded by beautiful ladies, never try to intimidate him. You will never know what he is hiding in his pants... ahem... his arsenal.’
So take my advice and peekaboo."

chapters.title: Chapter 302: Of Course, I am Threatening You {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: Who is Metal Saint Rocky, one might ask?
He is someone sitting at the peak of the Root Transcendent stage. He is a Saint-level blacksmith and holds considerable power in the Kyrrith Kingdom.
He has allies and friends in high places. It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that he is someone who cannot be offended, even by a king. His influence is very high and, well, supreme.
So why, then, did a mere Root Sage tell him to go hide, warning him of the consequences if he were to attack him?
Scratch that. Did Kent just say he was attacked yesterday but killed all of them?
"Clearly, he was joking, right?" someone asked, but the look on the faces of everyone listening to the interesting turn of events said it all.
The brat indeed said something like that, and right now, he had threatened someone he accused of sending assassins after him and his ladies.
That is just too wild.
"Are you threatening me? Do you know who I am?" Metal Saint Rocky asked through clenched teeth. It doesn’t take a genius to know he was very angry at the moment.
"I don’t know who you are, nor do I care. And of course, I am threatening you," Kent replied, raising an eyebrow.

"Why else would I say all those things if not to threaten you? I know you were part of those who tried to kill me and my ladies yesterday. If I were to display the bodies, some of those unfortunate mice would be your minions.
So yes, I am threatening you. And while you will boast and say you have the power to destroy me, know that I also have the power to end your existence within a minute.
If you don’t believe me, try attacking my soul again like you three did yesterday. Just indulge me and try. I will show you that in this life, there are some people you cannot piss off."
Elsa was already smiling and praying in her heart for the blacksmith to attack Kent. This will be her chance to show off her abilities.
Kent was getting angry, causing his aura to start to leak. But he held himself back from unleashing the aura of hatred and resentment Vexthra gave him.
"I thought so. All you know is how to make big words, but when it’s time for action, you chicken out," he sneered.
"Let this be a wake-up call to all those who sent 25 Great Sages and 7 Transcendents after me and my ladies yesterday. They are all dead, so stop looking for them.
Now, if you are still not convinced, then try again, and please, this time, come yourself. Having scum like you in this life is already an insult to some of us.
So, if you want, try again and see if you will succeed. You don’t know me, but I know you well enough to say none of you who came after me yesterday can succeed in killing me.
So let this be the first and last. If it happens again, don’t say I never warned you," Kent spoke in a cold tone that, for some reason, sent a chill down everyone’s spine.
The audacity of his words said it all: the brat is no easy cookie to crack.
⟪Proud of you, master. You’ve spoken like a true Dragon.⟫
’You can give me gifts instead,’ Kent nearly laughed. That would have destroyed the atmosphere he had created.
Though Gaia was just teasing him, he indeed had spoken with great authority.
"Ahem," Alina, who was standing and hearing all these threats being thrown in the air, cleared her throat.
"Let it be known that this is still the auction house, and as said yesterday, if you don’t have the money to win a bid, don’t resort to violence.
You two have broken that rule, and as such, you will be suspended from bidding on the last item tomorrow." Alina spoke like a true woman in authority.
This caused everyone to sigh in their hearts.
Banning Metal Saint Rocky was okay for them. But Kent is someone destined to make the last day of the auction memorable, so banning him didn’t sit well with them.
They wanted to protest, but they also didn’t want to anger Alina, who held a strict look on her face. She has all the power at the moment.
"My lady, this is their first offense, so why don’t you tone it down for them? Take it as me owing the Silver Leaf Auction House a favor," suddenly, a voice spoke from one of the VIP rooms.
"I hope that a favor from a kingdom protector can pardon them." The voice faded away, leaving everyone wide-eyed.
The person was gone, and the words she left behind were too much for even Alina to handle.
Suddenly, a beautiful lady wearing a veil appeared behind Alina and held her by the shoulder.
"Auction Master," Alina said, bowing slightly.
"No need for that, Alina. You have done a good job, even better than what I would have been able to do. So why don’t you let me take it from here?" the lady said, making Alina smile and step back.
The lady looked toward Kent’s VIP room and then at Metal Saint Rocky’s room.

"Under normal circumstances, you two would be banned from all auction houses operated by the Silver Leaf. But since a dignified person, a Kingdom Protector, has asked to pardon you, I will let this slide.
However, ensure this is the last time this happens while inside my auction house." The lady spoke, and the authority she exuded commanded obedience.
"Thank you for your benevolence, my lady," Metal Saint Rocky said, bowing slightly.

"My mom said when a beautiful angel speaks, you can only take it to heart and never let it slip away. So since you spoke, I can only take it to heart," Kent also said, but his words weren’t exactly what the lady in the veil was expecting.
However, she maintained her composure and continued.
"Since that is settled, I would like to announce that tomorrow we will be auctioning 75 items, of which only 5 will be Heaven-grade.
60 will be Legendary-grade items, two Mystical items, and seven will be like the skull that was just auctioned off.
But as for our last item to conclude this year’s auction, I don’t even know what it is. It was a last-minute addition from an anonymous seller, so we can only wait and see."
"Those who won bids today, come for them after we close. And those who didn’t, you can visit our Green Gate Bazaar later—some things will catch your attention.
See you all tomorrow."

chapters.title: Chapter 303: Kingdom Protector and Her Disciples {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: One could say the auction ended on a cliffhanger.
The three Metal Saints immediately vacated the auction house the moment the Auction Master finished her speech on what to expect the next day.
Those who didn’t win anything also left, and well, those who won their bids started moving to claim them.
Kent, however, noticed something when the supposed Kingdom protector left. The moment the voice faded, another presence vanished with her VIP room 4.
However, the most shocking thing was that before the Auction Master appeared, she first went to that VIP room.
So he knew two presences vanished a second before the Auction Master appeared. This also meant that whoever the second person was, they were not simple.
If a whole Auction Master, who is at the peak of the Ascension stage, personally delivered their purchase to them, then perhaps the auction this year has hidden dragons and crouching tigers within.
"Kent, do you think they will come again?" Unity asked.
"I don’t know, but you ladies won’t have to worry. The moment we go back, you will enter the tower, so just relax and spend time there. I will let you all know if something isn’t right."
"Okay," the ladies nodded.
They went for their stuff, with Kent taking his broken spear and the skull. Once they were done with everything, they left.
Meanwhile, the veiled lady, who was now standing atop a tall tower about five miles from the auction house, looked in the direction Kent and his ladies were going and sighed.
A few seconds later, another dark-veiled lady appeared with a young woman whose half-face was covered by a hood.
The veiled lady, upon noticing someone appeared beside her, bowed. "Master, you are here," she said with a smile hidden behind her veil.
"No need for the politeness, Lani. You are now an established cultivator and businesswoman. Give yourself some respect," the dark-veiled lady said.
"No, Master. You are a Kingdom protector, someone at your level deserves all my respect. You were the one who took me in and made me who I am today," Lani said.
She is the one who started the Silver Leaf Auction House and the main powerhouse of the Zephyr Merchant Family.
They call her Lady Lani or Auction Master, but her real identity is something that would shock anyone. She is a dangerous lady.
"You children are just too stubborn these days," the dark-veiled lady said, shaking her head.

"Just look at your junior sister. She has already reached the stage of becoming a Rank 3 Shadow Saint, but she wants to wait until she defeats all the geniuses in this kingdom before she enters seclusion and gains the enlightenment of the shadow.
Sometimes, I don’t know how you youngsters think."
The dark-veiled lady spoke like a thousand-year-old deity when, in fact, her appearance was that of a 22-year-old beauty.
Of course, she is over a thousand years old. She is at the peak of this world for a reason.
"Yami, you really should listen to the Master and break into the third rank. That will push your assassin abilities to the next level," Lani said, smiling.
"I will, Senior Sister. I just want to dominate the Sect competitions first before taking that step. The current me is akin to a Sword Saint with access to level 2 profound Qi.

This means I am on the same level as the swordsmen and spearmen who will be participating. If I manage to dominate that stage, I will be even more powerful when I break through," Yami said, not showing any emotion.

"Just being the disciple of a Kingdom protector is already you dominating," the dark-veiled lady, who nobody aside from the King, Lani, and Yami knew as the Kingdom Protector of the Athea Kingdom, spoke.
She is the most terrifying assassin you will ever meet.
"Master, I think she should do what her heart wants. After all, the disciples of the other three kingdom protectors will participate in the upcoming sect competitions in their various kingdoms.
This means the four will soon meet in the Kingdom Genius competition. If she manages to dominate this competition, she will feel confident against them."
"Whatever. Just know that a monster has appeared in the Sword Gate, and from what you have heard and seen, he is not afraid of multiple Transcendents coming after him.

This should tell you that he is not simple. So, if you don’t want to come crying, then you’d do well to take your training seriously, for you will be meeting someone you cannot underestimate," the dark-veiled lady said.
"Master, do you think he will be able to defeat Yami?" Lani asked.
"All I can say is that the brat who just made you rich is someone none of us can underestimate. Just looking at him has a certain effect on a person. He cannot be underestimated.
But don’t worry, Yami is someone who can easily kill a Transcendent if she puts her mind to it. However, she shouldn’t underestimate him either.
He is dangerous, and the way he spends his money means he is also resourceful."
"Then, Master, do you think I should get close to him?" Lani asked.
"If you are finally ready to give your virginity to him, then why not?" The veiled lady laughed, causing the two ladies behind her to wonder why she said that.
"It’s just about getting to know him. How would that result in me losing my virginity?" Lani asked, but the lady just kept laughing.

"I guess you are old enough, so why don’t you find out for yourself? Either way, I won’t avenge you if he sinks his fangs into you." With her laughter, she vanished alongside Yami, who was as confused as Lani.
"Master is a bit playful sometimes. How can a mere Root Sage take my virginity?" she muttered to herself and kept staring as Kent’s carriage moved away.
After a while, she vanished from the tower and went to see Alina, who had done more than one could give her credit for. She had to be rewarded.

The veiled lady, upon noticing someone appeared beside her, bowed.
"Master, you are here," she said with a smile hidden behind her veil.
"No need for the politeness, Lani.
You are now an established cultivator and businesswoman.
Give yourself some respect," the dark-veiled lady said.
"No, Master.
You are a Kingdom protector, someone at your level deserves all my respect.
You were the one who took me in and made me who I am today," Lani said.
She is the one who started the Silver Leaf Auction House and the main powerhouse of the Zephyr Merchant Family.
They call her Lady Lani or Auction Master, but her real identity is something that would shock anyone.
She is a dangerous lady.
"You children are just too stubborn these days," the dark-veiled lady said, shaking her head.
"Just look at your junior sister.

She has already reached the stage of becoming a Rank 3 Shadow Saint, but she wants to wait until she defeats all the geniuses in this kingdom before she enters seclusion and gains the enlightenment of the shadow.
Sometimes, I don’t know how you youngsters think."
The dark-veiled lady spoke like a thousand-year-old deity when, in fact, her appearance was that of a 22-year-old beauty.
Of course, she is over a thousand years old.
She is at the peak of this world for a reason.
"Yami, you really should listen to the Master and break into the third rank.
That will push your assassin abilities to the next level," Lani said, smiling.
"I will, Senior Sister.
I just want to dominate the Sect competitions first before taking that step.
The current me is akin to a Sword Saint with access to level 2 profound Qi.
This means I am on the same level as the swordsmen and spearmen who will be participating.
If I manage to dominate that stage, I will be even more powerful when I break through," Yami said, not showing any emotion.

"Just being the disciple of a Kingdom protector is already you dominating," the dark-veiled lady, who nobody aside from the King, Lani, and Yami knew as the Kingdom Protector of the Athea Kingdom, spoke.
She is the most terrifying assassin you will ever meet.
"Master, I think she should do what her heart wants.
After all, the disciples of the other three kingdom protectors will participate in the upcoming sect competitions in their various kingdoms.
This means the four will soon meet in the Kingdom Genius competition.
If she manages to dominate this competition, she will feel confident against them."
"Whatever.
Just know that a monster has appeared in the Sword Gate, and from what you have heard and seen, he is not afraid of multiple Transcendents coming after him.
This should tell you that he is not simple.
So, if you don’t want to come crying, then you’d do well to take your training seriously, for you will be meeting someone you cannot underestimate," the dark-veiled lady said.
"Master, do you think he will be able to defeat Yami?" Lani asked.
"All I can say is that the brat who just made you rich is someone none of us can underestimate.
Just looking at him has a certain effect on a person.
He cannot be underestimated.
But don’t worry, Yami is someone who can easily kill a Transcendent if she puts her mind to it.
However, she shouldn’t underestimate him either.
He is dangerous, and the way he spends his money means he is also resourceful."
"Then, Master, do you think I should get close to him?" Lani asked.
"If you are finally ready to give your virginity to him, then why not?" The veiled lady laughed, causing the two ladies behind her to wonder why she said that.
"It’s just about getting to know him.
How would that result in me losing my virginity?" Lani asked, but the lady just kept laughing.
"I guess you are old enough, so why don’t you find out for yourself?
Either way, I won’t avenge you if he sinks his fangs into you." With her laughter, she vanished alongside Yami, who was as confused as Lani.
"Master is a bit playful sometimes.
How can a mere Root Sage take my virginity?" she muttered to herself and kept staring as Kent’s carriage moved away.
After a while, she vanished from the tower and went to see Alina, who had done more than one could give her credit for.
She had to be rewarded.

chapters.title: Chapter 304: Curious Mara {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: "Kent, I want to have a private talk with you," Gate Master Mara said when they returned to the hotel.
Uncle Drew had taken it upon himself to book a new suite in a new hotel while they were away at the auction.
Kent nodded and turned to Selene.
"Take them to the Yin Pool. I will return later so we can spend some time together," he said. Selene and the rest of his women nodded with smiles on their faces as they vanished into the tower.
"What do you want to talk about?" Kent asked, turning toward the Gate Master.
"I want to ask you a question, and I would love to have a serious answer. Of course, if you are not comfortable, you can choose not to answer. Either way, I wouldn’t mind," she said.
"Okay. I’m listening," Kent replied.
"Are you a demon?" the Gate Master asked, nearly making Kent choke on his tongue. Of all the things he was expecting, this wasn’t one of them.
"Why did you ask that, if you don’t mind me asking?" Kent inquired instead of answering. The question wasn’t something he had anticipated at all.
"I’m not sure, but I think you have Dual Cultivation, and as far as I know, only demons have that," she answered, making Kent smile slightly.
"Again, what made you think I have dual cultivation?" he asked.
"If you don’t, then how do you explain the sudden level-ups? The first time I saw you, you were at the peak of the Root Grandmaster stage, and that was less than a month ago.
So, how do you explain the sudden leap to the Root Sage stage? Of course, you can say you have a high-tier spirit Root, but then again, you can’t go from Grandmaster to Sage in a month.
Also, your women are the same. They also moved by leaps and bounds, so unless they are also geniuses like you, there can be only one explanation: you have dual cultivation."
"So, are you a demon?" she asked again.

"You’re really smart, lady, but you’re wrong about something. I am not a demon, nor am I human either. Of course, I’ll let you guess my race, but I am not a demon," Kent said, making the gate master raise an eyebrow.
"You’re not human?" she asked.
"Big time. But like I said, you’ll have to guess. Not even my ladies know that. Well, Selene knows my real race, but I doubt she’ll be willing to share," Kent laughed.
"Just who are you?" Gate Master Mara asked, causing Kent to smile and move closer to her, holding her waist.
He pulled her close to his body, bringing their faces closer than ever. They could feel each other’s breath on their faces.
"You’ll find out soon enough," he said, moving his hand toward her butt. Her body shuddered, but she couldn’t gather the energy to move away.
Kent smiles and chooses to use the chance to make his own moves.
"You know, your sister told me you’re a good dancer. Care to bust a few moves for me to see?" Kent said, not getting too handsy yet, making sure the lady didn’t have her emotions in check.
"That... that was me before I became a swordsman, so I won’t be dancing. I left that life many years ago," she said, still in his arms. Her heart was beating faster than a pump.
"Then you must start practicing again, because your sister plans to send you out there when she is free from her cage," Kent said, now resting his hands on her ass.
"What are you doing?" she asked as she started to melt in his arms. "You still haven’t told me how you managed to learn dual cultivation."
She diverted the attention back to her question, hoping that would change anything.
"I’m not doing anything, and I didn’t learn dual cultivation. I’ve had it since birth," Kent replied.
He just didn’t know how to explain how he got dual cultivation without telling her all about his tower and its abilities.
So he lied.
"Then how come your ladies are also growing at the same speed as you? They are humans, that much I know, so how can they also use dual cultivation?" she asked.
"That’s because my seed is very powerful. Even though they don’t have dual cultivation, I do. So all I have to do is have sex with them, and we both grow stronger."
"But that shouldn’t be possible," she said, not understanding anything.
"You will understand soon enough," Kent said, gently cupping her butt through her clothes. This made her body shudder, causing Kent to smile.
He then massaged it again, feeling the softness before pulling away.

"Your body is really stiff. I have to take care of that, so why don’t you go back to the ladies? I have something to take care of first. When I am done, I will come so I can help you lighten up a bit."
"I don’t need a massage," she said, finally gaining some energy in her body.
"Are you sure about that?" Kent smiled, asking.
"I can let Selene massage me," she said, fearing for her purity. The brat was just too brazen. A mere touch from him had rendered her weak and defenseless.
"I am sure she will advise you to come to me. Trust me, I have already set my sights on you, so you can play hard to get all you want.
But deep down, you want me to give you some attention, so spend the next few hours with the ladies. Soon, you will be moaning in my bed.
Trust me, you want me inside you."
"In your dreams, maybe," the lady smirked as Kent waved his hand, sending her away.
⟪This cat is both intelligent and feisty. She is going to be a cute puppy soon.⟫
"You took the words right out of my mouth Gaia," Kent smiled, entering the legion tower.
Tower Master Mara appeared inside the love garden with a beating heart. She held her chest, calming her racing heart.
"So, the brat has gotten to you, huh?" Suddenly, a voice spoke from behind her, causing the gate master to turn, only to meet the gaze of the smiling Sword Saintess Selene.
"No need to resist it, Gate Master. You will feel good if you just accept your fate," Selene said.
She walked closer to her and led her toward the yin pool, where all the beautiful ladies were soaking naked in the pink pool.

chapters.title: Chapter 305: Creating The First Undead Legion {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: Kent appeared inside the Legion Tower and immediately entered the Necrosmith Forge since he wanted to start the first creation of his undead legion.
The moment he appeared, he moved toward a panel and pressed his palm on it. It lit up, and a voice spoke. Of course, the voice was similar to Akira in a way.
Naturally, the Creator Necromancy class was created by Akira, so it was only fitting for her voice to control the forge. It was a one-of-a-kind class.
[Welcome to the Necrosmith Forge. Do you want to create an undead?]
"Yes," Kent replied. He wasn’t surprised, simply because he had Gaia and Akira speaking in his head every single day.
[Do you want automatic creations or custom creations?]
"Custom," Kent answered.
The Necro Forge allows him to create undead by giving them names, which include their gender and even their nicknames if he desires, along with personalities and a job class of his choosing.
Of course, if the materials he adds have unique properties, the Forge will tweak them to accommodate all properties.
[Choose the name of your creation.]
"Kaizo. I want his name to be Kaizo, and a nickname that matches his personality, so do well to match that," Kent said.
Kent wasn’t about to use the first creation as a trial run. No, this was something he wanted to see succeed, and if he was lucky enough, he would be walking away with a powerful subordinate.
[Give the personalities of your creation.]
"This is tough, but I want my creation to have the following personalities: Cold but Honorable, Protective, Relentless in Battle, Loyal to His Cause, Fierce and Dominant, and Unyielding."
Kent gave the order, and the voice spoke again.
[Give a job class you want your creation to possess. Note that in the end, the class can change, but it will have the same root properties.]
"Brute Fighter," Kent said, and the cauldron, which had been still a moment ago, stirred and started humming.
[Add your creation materials.]
The cauldron-like item moved closer and opened for him to put the items in. Kent felt like this was just too childish, but then again, it was created by a child.
He knew Gaia and Akira were millions of years old, but he treated them like children, for in his eyes, they were children.
He looked to his left, and the bodies of all he had killed could be seen frozen and arranged for him to use. He contemplated whether he was to raise the items with his hands.
But before he could think, one body moved through the air and entered the cauldron.
’So that is how it works. It uses my thoughts,’
Kent said to himself before using his thoughts to move three Transcendent-level bodies, ten Great Sages. Then he extended his hand, and the skull appeared.

It was large, and the lightning crackling around it showed it was no ordinary item. He tossed it inside and then flicked his hand, dropping a hundred billion spirit stones into the forge like it was nothing.
’I have to multiply my wealth before tomorrow’s auction,’ he said to himself and then tossed the broken spear he bought from the auction into the cauldron.
He added some other stuff.
"That will be all," he said.
[Creation of the first undead has started. Estimated time of completion: 18 hours.]
"Ha. Looks like I’ll have to wait for a while," Kent sighed, then left and went back to the tower shop directly.
He called for Akira, who appeared instantly.
"Akira, tell me the Necrosmith shop uses the tower time when I use it inside the tower," Kent asked, but Akira smiled and scratched her head.
"Just great. Now, I have to wait 18 hours in outside world time before I get to meet my first undead," Kent sighed again.
[On the bright side, you’ll be having so much fun at the auctions tomorrow, so the time will pass quickly. Plus, you might just be surprised by what you’ll get, so don’t think too much about it.]
Akira said, trying to comfort her master.
"I’ll punish you later for making such a mistake," Kent said with a smile.
[Don’t punish me, please. I promise to fix it when you reach the stage to upgrade your class.] Akira pleaded, but Kent just gave her a teasing smile.
He then thought of a compromise, and his smile bloomed when something came to mind.
"Then how about you pick a skill from each of my ladies and make them crazily powerful?" Kent suggested.
[Would that take care of the punishment you had in mind?] she asked. Though she knew Kent was just playing with her, she liked to role-play.
In fact, before coming to this world, she was a popular anime voice and stage actor in a certain world—one she is currently praying they never visit in this life or the next.
Loli Queen Akiriana.
That was the name she used in that world, and they would come back to hunt her later.
"That would indeed handle the punishment," Kent assured her. "But while you’re here, what can you tell me about your third sister?"
[Dori? Well, she’s a weirdo if you ask me. While Gaia can see and go anywhere in the cosmos, Dori is all about thinking and coming up with insane theories.
She’s always on about this and that. She never truly makes sense when doing something. But she’s brilliant, and having her will be a good addition to your strengths.
However, if people who talk a lot bore you, then be sure to lock her up somewhere when you bring her," Akira said nonchalantly]
"It looks like you miss her," Kent said.
[Yeah. I miss that brat; she’s just too careless sometimes,] Akira sighed. She may act like it, but she cares about her sisters just as much as they care about her.
"Don’t worry, I’ll save her soon enough," Kent said, pulling up the interface for the store.
Gaia wasn’t around simply because she said she needed to focus all her attention on creating the paths Kent gave her.
He selected the Spirit Stone Roller Multiplier Bingo card and immediately purchased two. He then retrieved a manual from the storage and handed it to Akira.
"Give this to Gaia; it’s another path she must work on."
[She’s going to be ecstatic. Then I’ll be on my way.]
Akira left and appeared at the tower’s core, where Gaia and different versions of herself were working actively on the projects Kent had given her.
"You have another project, Gaia." She said, making the Loli, who had a pencil tucked behind her ear, like an architecture hard at work, smile cheerfully as she received the Path of Souls and Spirits.
It was the path the universe had gifted Elsa.
Akira smiled, and then she started weaving.

paragraphs: After getting what he wanted from the store, Kent teleported inside the Harem Tower, where he immediately appeared in the love garden.
"They’re inside the pool, huh?" Kent smiled and then reached out to Alina, who was also in the pool with them.
[Alina, dear, why don’t we meet inside the room for the reward I promised?]
Inside the pool, where all the ladies could be seen naked and submerged, Alina smiled and walked out of the pink water, causing the others to look at her with envious expressions.
The body walking out of the pool was just too gorgeous. And what she was going for was also something they all wanted, yet they couldn’t have it.
"Where are you going?" Unity asked.
"Nowhere," Alina smiled cutely.
"He’s here, isn’t he?" Selene, however, connected the dots, causing the gate masters and Val to look around while covering their chests.
"He just wants to give me my reward for doing such a good job today at the auction," Alina smiled and vanished.
Kent had given them the authority to move freely inside the Harem Tower, so while inside, she could use teleportation.
"Unbelievable. To think just being an auctioneer can be this rewarding. Maybe I should join an auction house," Elsa pouted.
"We’ll get our turn. She can have this one," Selene stepped in, noticing her sister’s jealousy of the big-butted auctioneer.
She then turned to the three ladies inside the pool, now calming down, considering Kent was nowhere near them.
They were having a good time inside the pool.

Deep within the core of the universe, a majestic bow that came from the Divine River arrived at the Quest Pool, where it merged with it and began stirring things up.

Soon, the one who died so her world and Family could live on and thrive would awaken, and her destiny would merge with that of a long-lost dead goddess who was once known for her impeccable handling of the Bow and Arrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 316: Quest Completed, Chrono Watch
paragraphs: ⟪Congratulations on completing the quest titled ’Scoring a Home Run’⟫
⟪Rewards: Received⟫
→ 2,000,000 Tower Points
→ True Name Token
→ Chrono Watch
"So, I now have two True Name tokens, and Lilian’s birthday is the day after tomorrow. I will be giving her one to awaken her potential and then move on from there.
Now, who should I give the next token to, considering Unity has already rejected it? Elsa already has one. Then who should I give it to?"
[The master can just give it to big sister Selene. She will be entering seclusion after the auction to rebuild her path.
I believe her having it will push her further much faster than if she goes on without a True Name.]
Akira spoke, appearing beside Kent.
"I was thinking the same thing, but what about the others? Though they will also be entering seclusion right when Gaia is done, I doubt I can rescue the two ladies before then."
Kent sighed. He will be receiving five True Name tokens after clearing that quest, so he wanted to wait until then.
But after talking with Mara and seeing how she wanted to let him have his way with her just so he could become strong, he realized that he had to speed up his rescue mission.
Also, he saw the need to turn his ladies into powerhouses.
If she thought of that, then the rest would also be thinking the same thing if they found out he had such a plan that required him to gather powerful warriors.
[The master is forgetting some things.
The quest to kill Bright Faywood is already in the bag. All you have to do is give the command, and he is dead. This will give you another True Name token.
Then, there is your night rider lady, Saden, who went on a mission with the ladies. They will be striking this evening, and by tomorrow morning, you will be swimming in Tower Points.
So, though one True Name token is ten million Tower Points, you can buy another one, if not two. This will set you at least five True Name tokens.

Now, Elsa and Unity are already excluded, leaving Lilian, Ingrid, Neomi, Selene, and Alina. Though the three ladies are not in the harem yet, they can have the five you will be receiving after the mission.
This means since you will be buying two more, you will have one for each other, the ladies currently in the harem.
Now, about the mission. You are forgetting you have an Undead on the way. You also have a Night Rider currently kidnapping Root Great Sages and Transcendents.
Though I don’t know why, I have a feeling that when you find out, you will be impressed. That alone should give you the confidence to know the mission will be happening faster than you think.
Of course, you also have one of the hardest metals in the universe currently in your possession and a battle doll with many skills in his arsenal.
If anything, you should be happy now because if—and this is a big *if*—if you get lucky on the last day of the auction, you will be walking away with more than you think.
In fact, if you plan it well, not even your ladies or the gate masters will be joining this rescue mission. You will have everything in the bag.
And let me tell you this: the reward after the mission is not something you can just throw away like that.]
Akira lectured Kent, showing him she was much more experienced than he was. Kent could only nod and smile from time to time.
"I might have forgotten about my gains for a moment there," Kent laughed.
[Maybe you should stop chasing skirts and pay more attention to your surroundings,] Akira giggled.
"Looks like you’re growing a pair, Akira," Kent said, making her continue to giggle as she walked away.

"Wouldn’t it be good if I don’t involve the ladies in this mission?" Kent smiled. "I guess I’ll make good use of the dungeons after the auction. If they do join, then I want the odds to be heavily in their favor."
Kent knew the ladies would beg him to let them fight. Even Vexthra, who knew of his plans, wanted him to include them.
So, he would plan it well and let them fight with the odds on their side.
"Paying a visit to the forest where the skull was found wouldn’t be bad either." After making a small side plan, he turned back to the quest rewards.
He took the item out, and it was a brown watch with no hour, minute, or second hand, nor was there a time displayed on it.
The only thing visible was a green circle on the screen. Kent quickly appraised it.
⟪Name: Chrono Watch⟫
⟪Grade: Mythic⟫
⟪Cooldown: 60 days⟫
→ When the line is green, and you tap the screen, you will be able to slow down time for thirty seconds. This will only affect those you target.
→ Once the thirty seconds are over, time will return to its normal speed.
→ Also, if you apply it to yourself, you will be able to speed up time for yourself for the next thirty seconds.
⟦Note: You will only be able to speed up time by 2.5x and slow it down by -2.5x. The 30 seconds is counted using the original time.
Also, if the strength of your opponent is far greater than yours, the effect might decrease or not work at all.⟧
"Damn, this is a good item," Kent said, quickly putting it on his wrist.
He didn’t need a genius to tell him that this was something he couldn’t look down on. The watch was a gem he had to take seriously.
Slowing down time for your opponents was like giving yourself a chance to kill them while they were in slow motion. But even if they were stronger than him, he could just speed himself up.
That was just too good. Kent turned to the additional rewards, and a smile appeared on his face.
⟪Additional Rewards:⟫
→ 7th Primordial Sword Path
→ 9th Primordial Sword Path
→ 3rd Primordial Spear Path
"Akira, come here. I’ve got some more projects for Gaia. Tell her I’ll reward her when she’s done with everything." Kent’s smile widened as he leaned back and closed his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 317: Uncle Drew’s Plan, Hell Demons
paragraphs: Uncle Drew had a chat with Kent yesterday after he found out what Kent did to those who attacked him and his ladies.
He then asked to handle the second day if they came again.
Kent just said okay and gave him the go-ahead to summon the battle doll whenever he wanted. He then moved inside the tower and started having fun with his ladies.
Not knowing, on the outside, 16 Root Great Sages and 2 Transcendents came after him. One was a Level Four Transcendent, and the other was Level Two.
They were all from the same camp, and just like what happened the day before, none of them walked out alive.
Well, some didn’t die, but none of them had the authority to leave.
Uncle Drew took care of them using all his strength. Right now, it’s 8 a.m. outside, and inside the master suite where Kent and his ladies were supposed to live, Uncle Drew could be seen meditating.
The metal doll was standing behind him with 10 dead bodies littered on the floor. None of them seemed to mind, but the moment Kent appeared, he waved his hand, and the bodies vanished.
"How did it go, Uncle Drew?" Kent asked, causing Uncle Drew to open his eyes and smile.

"It went better than I had hoped, Young Master. I managed to get two Transcendents and six Great Sages before I ran out of energy. The rest were killed by Titan," Uncle Drew said, causing Kent to raise an eyebrow.
"Where are they, then?" he asked.
He only counted 10 bodies, so where are the rest?
"They are in hell, Young Master," Uncle Drew smiled and stood up.
"Hell?" Kent looked puzzled. "Just what are they doing there?"
"I am turning them into hell demons. I am using the flames of hell and the authority I have as the captain of the Night Riders to turn them into hell demons, something only Night Riders can do."
"Wait a minute, are you saying you will be getting two Transcendents and six Great Sages as subordinates?" Kent asked, almost jumping up in joy.
"Yes, Young Master. All hell demons I create will be loyal to me," Uncle Drew was smiling as he said those words.
"This is good, then," Kent was also happy for him. He meant that if he were to add more battle dolls, he could rescue the two ladies sooner rather than later.
"I will be leaving after I take you back to the academy. I need to ensure the ritual goes perfectly," Uncle Drew said, and Kent nodded.
"If you need anything, don’t hesitate to ask," Kent said, and Uncle Drew smiled.
"You want to join the auction today, huh?" Kent could tell he wanted to do that. They are connected on the soul level, so he could feel it.
"There is something they will be auctioning tomorrow that I need," Uncle Drew said, making his reason for wanting to join the auction known.
"How did you know there was something there for you?" Kent asked. Even Alina doesn’t know what will be auctioned until the very last hour before the auction.
So then, how did he know?
"I sensed it when I dropped you off yesterday, so I checked it out later in the evening, and I know they will auction it today.
And don’t worry, not even the Root Ascension expert there wouldn’t have suspected a thing, even if they were in the room when I entered."
Kent sighed, shaking his head.
"I really should find a way to learn more about you, Night Riders."
Uncle Drew smiled.

If he were to tell Kent that he had to kill himself just so he could use the power of the dead to infiltrate the auction, Kent would probably open his mouth wide and stare at him like he was some kind of demon god.
"Go back to the tower for the meditation instead. We will leave within the hour, so recover as much as you can."
"Okay," Uncle Drew said, then vanished into the Legion Tower and began recovering.
Kent informed Alina about Uncle Drew joining the auction. Since he and his ladies would be occupied, he didn’t want to put Uncle Drew through that, so he would have his own VIP box.
Alina was put in a tight spot, but Kent told her to assign him to the VIP box meant for the Malric. She asked why, but Kent just told her to relax, as news would be reaching her soon.
Akira told him that Saden and her team would strike soon, and based on what she said, along with the sudden jump in his tower points, some people wouldn’t be making it to the auction.

"Time to multiply my wealth," Kent grinned and sat down. He used to have 3.2 trillion spirit stones, but he had used quite a lot and was now left with 2.7 trillion. Still, he could be considered very rich.
But it’s better to have more and worry about how to spend it.
"If things go well and I gain something I can use for another undead, I will pour 1 trillion spirit stones into it. Since I am more than rich, I can only use my wealth to gain power too."
He took out the two bingo cards.
They each could multiply their money by 1x, 2x, 4x, 6x... up to 20x. All he had to do was pump his energy into the card, and the number that appeared would multiply his wealth.
He channelled his energy into the first card, and within seconds, a number appeared, bringing a smile to Kent’s face.
"4 times, huh? Not bad for my luck." His wealth increased by 4, making him 10.8 trillion rich. He retrieved the next card and raised it up.
"I better get something cool so I can show off on the last day," Kent said before channelling his energy into it. The next second, the number appeared, and his smile widened.
"That’s what I’m talking about!" The battle doll was staring at him blankly.
"14 times," Kent burst into resounding laughter, making him get ready.
With 150 trillion-plus in spirit stones, he is perhaps the richest person in the entire world.

chapters.title: Chapter 318: The Last Day of the Auction
paragraphs: "Are you ladies ready?" Kent asked, looking at the lineup of some of the most beautiful ladies in the entire world standing in front of him.
"We are ready, dear," Selene answered, causing Kent to nod.
Using his mind, he moved everyone out of the tower straight into the carriage that was parked outside the hotel they were supposed to be staying in.
Why stay in a hotel when you have a tower?
The hotel was like a placeholder.
The ladies sat down, and Uncle started driving them back to the auction house.
"So today is the last day, huh? I wonder what they are going to sell," Ingrid said as they began moving toward the auction house.
They had asked Alina what would be sold, but she said she knew nothing, and even if she did, she wouldn’t say anything.
She wanted them to experience the full auction experience by getting excited when an item was revealed. If they knew in advance, they wouldn’t enjoy the auction.
Of course, a few minutes ago, she told them the items would cause many bidding wars that might escalate outside the auction house. So they were all wondering just what was being sold on the last day.
Then again, they knew if they saw something they wanted, they wouldn’t lose the bid, for they knew their man was super rich.
"You ladies don’t have to wonder about anything. Just get ready to bid when you see an item you want," Kent said to them, making them smile and look at each other.

"But how are we going to get back to the sect?" Unity asked. "I mean, Kent has already pissed off a lot of people. These people wouldn’t just let him go after the auction, so how are we going to get back to the sect?"
The ladies, who were all wondering the same thing, looked at Kent for a solution.
They had already been attacked twice, so who was to say they wouldn’t try a third time? They were obviously worried for their man. Kent simply smiled and spoke.

"You ladies shouldn’t worry. Right now, what you should be concerned about is how many people you’re going to piss off this last day. Getting back to the academy will be as easy as walking through the front gate."
"Are you sure? If you’re not certain, you can ask the Sword King for a favor. From the way he spoke last time, I’m sure he’d be happy to escort us back to the academy," Lilian said.

"I’ll consider that. But as I said, you ladies shouldn’t be worried. By the time we get to the gates of the academy, I’m sure some of these people will be on their knees begging me to forgive them," Kent said with an evil smile, making the ladies wonder what sinister plan he was cooking up.

After moving through the busy streets for a couple of minutes, they arrived at the auction house, where some of the most luxurious carriages were dropping off the rich and wealthy who had come for the last day of the auction.
There were hundreds of people there.
Some were talking to their fellow rich folks, while some were giving each other stares. The rivalry could be seen and felt vividly.
Immediately, Kent and his ladies alighted from their carriage; everyone turned toward them.
Killing intents were locked on them from all directions. It was like they had been waiting for him to appear so they could do that.
It was quite funny watching this rich folk act this way. It was like they were just not living up to their values.
Kent smirked and then turned toward his right.
There, he came face to face with the three Metal Saints: Rocky, Adolf, and Andrew, who, thanks to Kent, had let go of their grudges and chosen to team up against him.
"Brat, have your fun today, for after the auction, you will not live long to enjoy it," Metal Saint Andrew threatened, not minding the many people listening.
"Oooh, I am so scared. Look, there are goosebumps on my skin," Kent grinned, watching the expressions of the three blacksmiths darken.

"Let me make something clear," Kent turned and looked at everyone around. "I won the bids, yet they are trying to steal from me. Personally, I want them to come after me, for that will give me an excuse to kill them.
Now, if you wake up in the coming days and hear that one of these three—or perhaps all three of them—are dead, none of you should try to seek revenge for them.
Trust me, you wouldn’t want your families to pay for your foolishness.
So I’ll say this once: If you three come after me, I promise you, I will kill you, and not even your backers will be able to do anything about it."
Kent spoke with a smile on his face as he started to move inside. After a few steps, he stopped and looked back at the three.
He still had some things to get off his chest.
"I was initially planning to give you a chance to buy something today, but because of your threat, I will bid ten times the price, even if it’s a needle.
What I mean is, today, the three of you won’t be walking away with even a beast core." Kent laughed and left with his ladies, who were trying to hold back their laughter.
The look on the three blacksmiths’ faces was just too amusing.
After Kent left, the three Blacksmiths exchanged looks and also entered the auction house. They had already made up their minds: they and Kent could not live on the same continent after the auction.
However, for now, they would try their best to show the brat that they were not known as Metal Saints for nothing—they were rich enough to handle someone like him.
Unfortunately for them, all the materials they would bid on were things Kent needed for his next undead creation.
In a way, Kent also needed anything a blacksmith needed; thus, their animosity would only grow with each item up for bidding.
A while later, everyone was seated, and Alina appeared on the stage with a smile.
"Welcome, everyone, to the last day of the annual auction. Before we start, I would like to share some unfortunate news," Alina said calmly.

"It is with regret that I report the entourage from the Malric family, which includes the head of the Malric noble family, met an unfortunate end at the hands of unknown assailants on their way to the final day of the auction.
None of them survived. Our condolences go out to them and their family."
Alina spoke like the most sympathetic person alive, though in truth, she was more than happy to hear that such scum of a family had been massacred.
At that very moment, the rest of their family, involved in the slave business, were being hunted and killed as she spoke.
Saden and her three teammates were doing a thorough house cleaning, for she wouldn’t be happy until they were all dead.
"Now, before we begin, the Auction Master would like to say a few words," Alina said as the veiled beauty who had appeared the previous day walked onto the stage.

Right now, what you should be concerned about is how many people you’re going to piss off this last day.
Getting back to the academy will be as easy as walking through the front gate."
"Are you sure?
If you’re not certain, you can ask the Sword King for a favor.
From the way he spoke last time, I’m sure he’d be happy to escort us back to the academy," Lilian said.
"I’ll consider that.
But as I said, you ladies shouldn’t be worried.

By the time we get to the gates of the academy, I’m sure some of these people will be on their knees begging me to forgive them," Kent said with an evil smile, making the ladies wonder what sinister plan he was cooking up.

After moving through the busy streets for a couple of minutes, they arrived at the auction house, where some of the most luxurious carriages were dropping off the rich and wealthy who had come for the last day of the auction.
There were hundreds of people there.
Some were talking to their fellow rich folks, while some were giving each other stares.
The rivalry could be seen and felt vividly.
Immediately, Kent and his ladies alighted from their carriage; everyone turned toward them.
Killing intents were locked on them from all directions.
It was like they had been waiting for him to appear so they could do that.
It was quite funny watching this rich folk act this way.
It was like they were just not living up to their values.
Kent smirked and then turned toward his right.
There, he came face to face with the three Metal Saints: Rocky, Adolf, and Andrew, who, thanks to Kent, had let go of their grudges and chosen to team up against him.
"Brat, have your fun today, for after the auction, you will not live long to enjoy it," Metal Saint Andrew threatened, not minding the many people listening.
"Oooh, I am so scared.
Look, there are goosebumps on my skin," Kent grinned, watching the expressions of the three blacksmiths darken.
"Let me make something clear," Kent turned and looked at everyone around.
"I won the bids, yet they are trying to steal from me.
Personally, I want them to come after me, for that will give me an excuse to kill them.
Now, if you wake up in the coming days and hear that one of these three—or perhaps all three of them—are dead, none of you should try to seek revenge for them.
Trust me, you wouldn’t want your families to pay for your foolishness.
So I’ll say this once: If you three come after me, I promise you, I will kill you, and not even your backers will be able to do anything about it."
Kent spoke with a smile on his face as he started to move inside.
After a few steps, he stopped and looked back at the three.
He still had some things to get off his chest.
"I was initially planning to give you a chance to buy something today, but because of your threat, I will bid ten times the price, even if it’s a needle.
What I mean is, today, the three of you won’t be walking away with even a beast core." Kent laughed and left with his ladies, who were trying to hold back their laughter.
The look on the three blacksmiths’ faces was just too amusing.
After Kent left, the three Blacksmiths exchanged looks and also entered the auction house.
They had already made up their minds: they and Kent could not live on the same continent after the auction.
However, for now, they would try their best to show the brat that they were not known as Metal Saints for nothing—they were rich enough to handle someone like him.
Unfortunately for them, all the materials they would bid on were things Kent needed for his next undead creation.
In a way, Kent also needed anything a blacksmith needed; thus, their animosity would only grow with each item up for bidding.
A while later, everyone was seated, and Alina appeared on the stage with a smile.
"Welcome, everyone, to the last day of the annual auction.
Before we start, I would like to share some unfortunate news," Alina said calmly.

"It is with regret that I report the entourage from the Malric family, which includes the head of the Malric noble family, met an unfortunate end at the hands of unknown assailants on their way to the final day of the auction.
None of them survived.
Our condolences go out to them and their family."
Alina spoke like the most sympathetic person alive, though in truth, she was more than happy to hear that such scum of a family had been massacred.
At that very moment, the rest of their family, involved in the slave business, were being hunted and killed as she spoke.
Saden and her three teammates were doing a thorough house cleaning, for she wouldn’t be happy until they were all dead.
"Now, before we begin, the Auction Master would like to say a few words," Alina said as the veiled beauty who had appeared the previous day walked onto the stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 319: A Heavy Announcement
paragraphs: The lady walked to the stage and placed her hand on Alina’s shoulder.

Though a veil covered her face, Kent could tell she was very beautiful. Perhaps she was just too beautiful, and she didn’t want people gawking at her wherever she went, so she decided to put on a veil.
’Soon, all these damsels will start wearing veils, or else I will always find myself facing jealous bastards,’ Kent thought to himself as the lady took the stage.

"First off, I would like to send my condolences to the Malric Noble Family for their loss. This is a cultivation world, and things like this tend to happen. However, it’s always tragic to hear when it does. We can only remember them in our hearts."
Her words touched everyone, making them nod with solemn expressions.
’Tsk, everyone listens to the beautiful lady. But I think we all know they are simps’ Kent smiled.
"Now, to the reason I interrupted the auction. I have an announcement to make," she said, looking around the auction house.
"We all know that exactly a month from now, the Pill Master Competition will take place in this very city. We all know how important that is, so I expect we will all be there.
I know I would be there to witness the Perfect Alchemist, who promised to make his appearance there.
Then, two months later, we have the Sect Competition, which happens every three years. This will allow us to select the seven representing our kingdoms in the Kingdoms’ Genius Competition."
Now, I know we all will be there to witness the rising stars of our kingdom and also know the seven that will go ahead and represent the kingdoms.
Now, to my announcement.

A month after the Sect Competitions, the Silver Leaf Auction House will be organizing an expedition to explore the Ancient Battlefield of Parting, specifically, the location where the mineral auctioned on the first day was found.
Rumour has it that there is more than one mineral of different uses and values there. Of course, you will find out more in the coming hours, but we will be exploring there.

Now, while I would like to say you all are invited, we will only be adding ten more to our team. This means only ten of you will have the chance to join us, as the Root Sovereign, who will be leading the expedition, can only take ten more with her."
"How can we apply, Auction Master?" somebody shouted from the stands, causing everyone to nod.

"It’s simple, actually," the lady smiled from behind her veil. "You can go to the Dark Room and pick any Calamity mission. If you manage to clear it by the day of the sect competitions, you will be added."
"What?"
Everyone who heard the application method instantly lost the idea of joining the expedition. It was like staring at the bum of someone only to turn, and it’s your buddy pranking you.
You will instantly lose interest and perhaps attack them.
A Calamity mission.
Something that even Root Ascension Stage experts would struggle with, and she was now asking them to pick one from the Dark Room, too.
The Dark Room is the most dangerous space in every kingdom. That place is where the most dreadful Calamity-rank missions are posted.
In essence, calamity missions are akin to death waiting to claim anyone stupid enough to come crawling.
Even if it were picked from a sect, no sane person would want to embark on such a mission. Then why would they pick one from a Darkroom of all places?
Rumor even has it that a Hell mission was posted there years ago, and because of that mission, hundreds died.
In fact, Calamity missions from the Dark Room are one of the major causes of death in all four kingdoms.
So, if she is telling them to go clear a Calamity mission, is she perhaps asking them to go and die?
"This will be a mission to an uncharted territory where only a handful who manage to touch its borders return. So, the requirement to join isn’t something you should think will be easy.
However, those who make it will return with huge rewards. Trust me, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Try your best to grab it."
"That will be all." After saying that, she left, allowing Alina to handle the rest.
The announcement just now was too much for any of them to process immediately. The variables in the announcement were too enticing for many to ignore.
So, even though she told them the requirements were impossible, some still began to consider it.

If they could enter this place with the team from Silver Leaf, their chances of survival would be significantly higher. Naturally, the team would include a Root Sovereign, so they were all weighing their options.
Kent had similar thoughts but was on a different wavelength.
’If I get inside this Ancient battlefield, I’ll be able to gather materials for more undead. After all, I still have to deal with the Dark Devil Church and the Hand.
No one will help me, so I must take matters into my own hands and start making bold decisions.’
The ladies around him could tell what he was thinking, so they exchanged glances and sighed.
They all wanted him to be happy, so while Kent was contemplating his next move, they also sought ways to bring him joy.
"Kent, don’t think too much. By the time that moment arrives, you will be ready to enter there. We will make sure of that," Selene said, making Kent nod.
His head, now resting on Mara’s chest, settled back on what could only be described as the most comfortable pillow one could ask for.
Mara tried to object to this arrangement, but the ladies wouldn’t take no for an answer. Kent, however, was very pleased with the setup.
"I have to say, you ladies know how to make a man happy," Kent said, resting the side of his face between Mara’s breasts.
"You deserve the best, love," Selene replied. She was the most active in the harem, so the ladies allowed her to devise all the bold plans.
Camilla and Val were also in their usual positions, waiting for the right moment to gather the courage to express their feelings.
In the end, Kent finds himself in the best situation a man could ask for, and it is all thanks to his ladies doing their utmost to keep him happy.
"Now that we’ve all heard from the Auction Master, why don’t we get started with the auction?" Alina asked.
"The same rules apply. If your pocket isn’t deep enough to win a bid, don’t try to threaten or intimidate anyone.
If you ignore this warning and attempt to intimidate others, you won’t just be banned from this auction house—you’ll be banned from all businesses owned by Silver Leaf."
Alina allowed her words to sink in before gesturing for the first item to be brought forward.
"For our first item of the day, a Heaven-grade sword crafted by Metal Saint Colins. The starting bid is set at 2 million, with a minimum increment of 100,000."
"The bidding starts now."
And just like that, the last day of the auction was underway.

chapters.title: Chapter 320: First Legendary Grade Item
paragraphs: "The sword is sold for 67 million to the lady in VIP room 15."
Alina’s voice rang out, signaling that the first item had finally found an owner in less than 30 minutes.
The bidding this time was swift, and the prices called out by many were far beyond the standard value one might place on the sword.
But it was sold quickly, and another sword was brought forward.
"The next item is also a Heaven-grade sword, crafted by Metal Saint Bruce. The bidding starts at 2 million, with a minimum increment of 100,000. The bidding starts now."
"4 million!" someone shouted.
"6 million!"
"10 million!"
The prices began to climb rapidly, causing everyone interested in the sword to grow increasingly competitive. This sword, crafted by one of the 14 Metal Saints, was not something to be taken lightly.
The Auction Master had announced yesterday that there would be only five Heaven-grade items today, and so far, this was the second one being auctioned, meaning the remaining three would follow soon.
Those who desired the Heaven-grade sword continued to bid, while others who preferred to observe and see how the event unfolded kept a close watch.
Forty minutes later, the sword was sold to another lady in VIP room 17.
Kent could not see them since the formations were now preventing anyone, not even the Transcendents, from peeking at anyone.
But he told them they were all disciples from the top sects who came for the last day of the auction. Two managed to get lucky.
The second sword was sold for 80 million.
Then, the next item, a weapon, was brought out—a heaven-grade spear crafted by Metal Saint Willie, one of the finest blacksmiths from the Athea Kingdom.
Kent could tell this was the auction house’s way of showing their respect to the Blacksmiths.
The item was also sold quickly for a whopping 120 million.
This time, it was bought by a young man inside VIP room 78.
The auction house is big enough to accommodate that many rooms. This time, the voice also sounded to Kent like it belonged to someone from a top sect.
Naturally, he was spot on. Every sect had sent their top disciples. Some came on the first day but didn’t bid. Others didn’t come for either the first or the second day despite being nearby.
The fourth item came, and it was an axe made by Metal Saint Ronald. This bid lasted only 15 minutes, but the item was sold for 130 million.
It was a rather good axe with a beautiful design.
After the fourth, the last heaven-grade item for the day was brought out, and it wasn’t something anyone could ignore.

It was a heaven-grade herb that, when eaten raw, would boost one’s cultivation base by three levels. A very powerful herb, it was brought back from the Demon Mountains, one of the many dreadful places in all of the four kingdoms.
It was the place where Saden was awakened by Uncle Drew to become a Night Rider. It was also the place where most herbs can be found.
Though dangerous, with rumors saying one of the Forest Kings resides there, many still frequent there, for if they are lucky, they will be walking away rich men and women.
(A/N: Forest Kings are the Spirit beasts at the same level as the Kingdom Protectors. They are standing at the peak of this world)

"It took a team of seven Root Great Sages to ward off the beast protecting this herb before it was brought here. After appraisal, it was discovered that it was on the same level as heaven-grade items.
The bid is set at 20 million, with a minimum increment of 2 million. The bid starts now."
"30 million!" A sweet voice shouted the first bid from VIP room 30, but she was outbid the next second.
"40 million."
"50 million," the sweet voice spoke again.
"That voice sounds strangely familiar," Selene said, perking her ears to hear the voice again. "I have heard that voice somewhere before."
She tried to remember where she had heard the voice.
"That is the voice of the disciple of that Poison Witch who threatened to destroy the sect a couple of weeks ago if I wasn’t brought out"
Kent said, prompting the ladies who had witnessed that event to immediately place a name to the voice.
"Looks like she really needed that herb," Neomi said.ree
"Indeed," Kent smiled.
"Don’t tell me you’re going to buy it from her," Selene, who saw the reason behind that smile, said, making the ladies look at Kent with varied expressions.
"I won’t bother with her now, so she can buy this one if she has the money." Strangely, Kent didn’t continue with his evil plan.
Of course, he contemplated snatching it from her, but then again, she was bound to him, so her master wouldn’t be able to do anything to him.
"I’m sure her master is with her inside; that’s why she’s bidding such outrageous amounts," Mara said, narrowing her gaze at VIP room 30, though she saw nothing.
"She is indeed there," Ingrid said looking toward the VIP room. Her void eyes allow her to see through any obstacle. The formations were not much to block her from peeping.
"240 million!" Annabelle shouted, raising the price from 190 to 240 million. Just like that, she managed to ward off the other bidders and won the bid for a whopping 240 million spirit stones.
Though it was a lot of money, it wasn’t something she would be concerned about, considering her master was a Pill Saint, someone whose wealth was immense.
"Looks like the big games are about to start," Kent said with a smile.
"You’re about to make more enemies, huh?" Mara, who was getting comfortable and was now rubbing Kent’s chest through his open shirt, said.
"They just choose to be my enemies when, in fact, they should have realized this was an auction where the rich get to have what they want.
But of course, since they want to take offense and try to attack me, then I can only prepare and wait for them to come."

"There’s no stopping it, I guess," she muttered. Though she would love to cut a few heads off, her priority now was getting her sister back, so if possible, she would prefer not to have outside enemies.
They still have to deal with the monster inside the sect.
"Just relax. They’ll understand why they shouldn’t mess with me soon enough," Kent said, rubbing her thighs.
’She’s not wearing anything underneath. Just what did the ladies do to her to make her take such bold action?’ Kent wondered as he rubbed her thighs up to the waist area to confirm.
Indeed, she was not wearing anything under her gown. This made Kent’s libido surge, causing little Kent to stir, creating an outline in his trousers.
The ladies saw this, and they all blushed. Val and Camilla, who were the closest, tried to look away, but Selene and the rest of the ladies met their gaze and smiled at them.
Obviously, they were about to have their first encounter.
"For the next item, we have a legendary-grade poison sac from an unknown serpent-type spirit beast. The bid is set at 100 million, with a minimum increment of 10 million.
Let the bidding begin."

chapters.title: Chapter 321: Bone Melting Poison Sac
paragraphs: The poison sac is being kept in a glass, which was reinforced using formations to prevent any leakages. Such a deadly poison cannot be allowed to leak out like that.
Kent, who heard what Alina said, raised his head and looked at the poison sac. He immediately scanned it using his enchanted eyes.
⟪Name: Bone Melting Poison Sac⟫
⟪Danger Level: Very Dangerous⟫
→ This is a poison sac from a Root Sovereign-Stage Bone Melting Serpent Beast.
→ Just like its name, its venom is very lethal. A single drop can kill anything at the Root Sovereign stage and below.
→ When used with other ingredients, it can create poison pills that can even melt the bones of a Core Formation stage expert.

chapters.title: Chapter 323: Mask of the Underworld
paragraphs: Name: Mask of the Underworld
Grade: Mythic
→ Long before the Battle of the Parting, there was a soul cultivator widely known as the Ferryman.
→ He was called this simply because he was rumoured to have the means to enter the underworld and ferry souls back to the land of the living.
→ Of course, these were just rumours. However, those who believed these rumours tried to find out how he did it, but none succeeded.
→ None of them realized, however, that the only way he could enter that place was because of the infamous mask he possessed.
→ The Mask of the Underworld.
→ This mask was rumoured to belong to one of the Seven Kings of the Underworld.
→ It allows the wearer to enter the underworld and visit all 14 layers without fear of their soul being trapped—unless, of course, they lose the mask while there.
→ It also enables the wearer to take souls from the underworld and bring them to the land of the living. All souls taken with the mask will be loyal to you.
→ All souls brought back using the mask will turn into haunting soul spirits.
Kent read the details of the ugly mask, and for a moment, his interest piqued. However, a voice entered his head the next second, causing him to back down immediately.
[Young Master, this is the item I was talking about,] Uncle Drew said, and Kent could only back down to let his Night Rider Captain acquire it.
’Go ahead, Uncle Drew. When the bidding starts, you can buy it,’ Kent said before leaning back into the waiting embrace of the Spear Gate Master.
"Everyone, though this mask is ugly, rumour has it that it once belonged to a powerful soul cultivator long before the Battle of the Parting.
Now, I don’t know what it can do or how to use it, but I know one thing: this mask is extremely valuable.
This is why it’s in this category. The bid is set at 200 million, with a minimum increment of 10 million.
Let the bidding begin!"
"300 million," Alina wasn’t even done speaking when someone bid on the mask. It wasn’t Uncle Drew.
This caused Kent to wonder just who the bidder was. However, it didn’t take long for more voices to join the bidding.
Kent smirked, knowing that a few collectors were now looking to add such a powerful mask to their collections instead of taking the time to research its true value.
But since he already knew who would win the bid, he simply lay there, rubbing Camilla’s thighs and causing her to blush profusely.
Val, who was tired from rubbing the dragon through his trousers, began contemplating whether she should remove his pants and go for the real thing instead.
The other ladies noticed this and chose to wait and see what decision she would make.
Meanwhile, the bid for the mask had already reached the billions and was climbing quite quickly.
It seemed some people truly wanted to possess something that existed before the Parting. Before that battle, the world was very different.
Powerful cultivators were everywhere, so an artefact from that era was highly coveted.
Thirty minutes later, the mask was sold to Uncle Drew, who had had enough of the bidding. He raised the bid from 25 billion to 70 billion, silencing everyone and securing the mask.
Kent had provided him with more than enough money to use as he pleased, so Uncle Drew didn’t hesitate to go all in and win.
[Thank you, master. With this, I will be able to grow my and my fellow Night Riders’ strength many times faster,] Uncle Drew said to Kent through telepathy.
’You are welcome. But if you don’t mind me asking, what do you intend to do with the mask?’ Kent wanted to know if he was aware of the true nature of the mask.
[Although none could recognize this mask, it’s actually a mask that allows one to enter the underworld, where the souls of the dead reside.
It also enables one to bring back souls that can be converted into soul spirits.
Of course, I plan on using these souls as materials to strengthen my Hell demons. Soul spirits are good, but Hell demons are far better.] He smiled as he said that.
’But aren’t you already from Hell? Why do you then need a mask before you can enter there?’ Kent asked.
He knew that much about Night Riders because Uncle Drew had told him. So then, if he is from Hell, why does he need a mask to access it?

[I am from Hell, but Hell and the underworld are two different places. The underworld is where souls go after the body dies. Hell is where souls are banished when they fall out of line in the underworld.
There are fourteen levels of the underworld, governed by the 7 Underworld Kings and 7 Underworld Fiend Queens. As for Hell, there are 13 levels, and a calamity governs each level.
However, beyond its thirteen levels, there is a fourteenth level where the flames of the night burn. It’s my home and where all Night Riders come from.]
’I see. This is actually quite educational. Thanks, Uncle Drew. I hope with this mask, you can grow as you said.’ Kent smiled, knowing his subordinate had obtained something worth dying for.
’Taking souls from the underworld and using them to upgrade his Hell demons. That sounds intriguing. I’d like to see the outcome someday.’
Kent continued to observe the auction as more and more items were brought to the stage and auctioned to the highest bidders.
Suddenly, he felt his trousers loosen, and then slowly, they were pulled down, revealing his hardened member, demanding attention.
Val’s face turned red, as did Camilla’s when they both saw the dragon for the first time.
"Go ahead, Val. This is your chance to get closer to him. Do your best, for the reward you’ll taste is something you can never have enough of," Selene said, licking her lips.
Val trembled slightly but then touched the shaft and brought it to her face before taking it into her mouth. Camilla blushed, knowing it was only a matter of time before her turn came.
