chapters.title: Chapter 327: Domain Crystal, Intense Bidding War
paragraphs: The final phase of the auction began, and the bidding war became fiercer than before. Before the break, there were 10 items left.
Of the ten, seven legendary-grade items, two mystical and one unknown.
The auction resumed, and six out of the seven legendary-grade items were sold, with the cheapest being bought at 600 billion spirit stones.
One could only wonder how much the mystical items would sell for.
However, that was answered right after the last legendary grade item was sold, and right now, another crystal is displayed.
Everybody started wondering just what this crystal could do, so when Alina mentioned its name, everyone reached for their wallets and purses.
"This is what we call a Domain Crystal. As its name suggests, this item came from the Ancient Battlefield and was formed from the clash between laws.
We don’t know what type of laws or how many were captured in this crystal, but I know for a fact that this is something for those who want to have a chance at entering the Root Sovereign stage.
I don’t have to say much. You all know what a Domain Crystal can do, so the bidding is set at 150 billion with a 100 million minimum increment.
The bidding starts now."
"400 billion..."
"420 billion..."
The bidding started with a huge leap, making the next bid enter a heated stage where everyone was now trying their luck.

⟪The master should do whatever is required to get this crystal. In fact, the master shouldn’t worry about who he offended. This crystal is something you will need for the next couple of undead you will be creating.⟫
’You don’t have to mention it, Akira. This is something I will never let slip through my fingers.’
⟪It’s good the master recognizes value.⟫
Kent smirked, and then he got serious. He could already start hearing new voices, and from the pressure behind those voices, he could tell they were not people he could trifle with.

Yet the allure of having such a treasure was more than enough to make him offend these people. In fact, after seeing the details of his first undead, he knew the second and third were already going to be monstrous.
Then this crystal appeared, and he knew he was going to become a terror in the coming weeks. He himself wants to become monstrous, and the only way of growing is to face dangers.
And he knew after this auction, his life would become much more monstrous.
"700 billion," a voice spoke, and the next followed, raising the price by ten billion. A few seconds later, the price reached 800 billion, and dozens reached their limit.
Then, only the big three remained.
However, there was another voice, a feminine one, that joined the bid when it reached 600 billion. Kent observed quietly until the price climbed to 850 billion.
That was when the three Metal Saints, who had proven to hold considerable wealth, chose to show everyone they were not poor.
"960 billion."
At this point, a record was about to be broken—a record set over two decades ago when the final item of the auction was displayed.
It was an Ambrosia apple, and it sold for 1.5 trillion spirit stones. That sale was what propelled the Silver Life Auction House to its current prominence.
So, seeing an item approach that milestone, one could only hope it would be surpassed. This would not only solidify the auction house’s reputation but also extend its reach to many more businesses.
"The gentleman in VIP room 10 bids 960 billion. Are there any more bids?" Alina called out, making everyone fall silent as they waited for someone to join in.

"The gentleman in VIP room 10 bids 960 billion. Are there any more bids?" Alina repeated, bringing a smile to the faces of the three Metal Saints, who were thinking, ’Finally, the brat has run out of money.’
They were already planning to rub it in his face as they took the other items he had bought right after they slit his throat.
That was their plan. Unfortunately, he meant every word when Kent promised to shatter their hopes and dreams.
"A Domain Crystal, huh? Adding it to my collection wouldn’t be a bad thing," Kent spoke and smiles spread across the faces of everyone who had been expecting him to bid.
"I bid 2 trillion."
Kent spoke his bid, and just like the ones he made before, everyone fell silent. A pin-drop stillness filled the room.
"The gentleman in VIP room 13 bids 2 trillion. Are there any more bids?" Alina asked, already smiling inwardly.
"The gentleman in VIP room 13 bids 2 trillion. Are there any more bids?" she called out again, but nobody made any further bids.
"Since there are no more bids, the Domain Crystal is sold to the gentleman in VIP room 13." Kent won the bid, and a loud slam echoed from VIP room 10.
The three Metal Saints left, and from the way they marched out, one could tell they were furious at the turn of events.
"Looks like somebody is in trouble," Unity teased Kent, who smiled and leaned back into Mara’s embrace.
"Trouble seems to find me even when I’m just being myself. But this is good. I’ll finally be able to test my strength against the schemes of three Transcendents."
He smiled, knowing avoiding this battle between him and the three Metal Saints was inevitable.
"Just make sure you don’t get hurt," Lilian said, and Kent nodded.
"But even if you get hurt, make sure the dragon between your legs remains healthy. That’s the only way we can ease your pain," Selene added, making the ladies blush.
They had just had a marathon with their man, and from the look of things, they had succeeded in planting the seed of lust in another lady.
The rest would depend on whether or not Alina was able to get the Ambrosia apple from Kent.
Naturally, she had already fallen when she couldn’t turn and run after seeing what Kent and his ladies were doing.
She saw everything, and when she finally recovered, she remembered what her master had told her.
This scared the life out of her.

But in the coming weeks, whenever she felt lonely, the images would surface, and from there, she would start to realize that perhaps she had fallen into a perfectly crafted plan put together by her own employee.

chapters.title: Chapter 328: Forest King, Berserker Lava Wolf (1)
paragraphs: After buying the domain crystal, Kent didn’t bid on any other items. The remaining items were two mystical-grade swords, which were bought by Val and Mara.
The flying sword was made from the spine of a beast known as the Nimble Spine Rabbit. It was thin and deadly, and according to the description read by Alina, its speed triples when in use.

In fact, the silent nature of the sword’s movement, combined with its durability and lethality, caused the bidding to last for 30 minutes, with Val ultimately purchasing it for 980 billion spirit stones.
She didn’t hesitate to spend her man’s money, unlike her sisters, who were holding back from spending too much.
The last sword was bought by Mara after an intense bidding battle with Sword King Shawn.
In fact, the battle was so intense that if Kent hadn’t intervened and promised to give the Sword King something of equal value, it wouldn’t have ended well.
Mara wanted to buy that sword for her sister, so she didn’t back down from the fight. In the end, however, everything worked out.
Kent walked away with two happy women, and the Sword King would be receiving something of equal value in return.
It was a win-win for both sides. Kent, who knew his life would become chaotic after the auction, could only sigh.
"That was one intense battle. Thankfully, it ended better than we all anticipated. Now, since that is settled, we can move on to the last item, which even I know nothing about.

It was a last-minute addition, specifically requested to be sold as the final item. We don’t know what’s inside, but we know it’s something we cannot ignore, considering the one who brought it—someone we cannot even comprehend."
Alina took a card that was brought to her by another lady. Then, the mechanized table moved, and a 2-meter-wide and tall box, impenetrable to the eye and senses, was revealed.
She opened the card, and for a moment, her expression froze.
"I will now read what the card says, for even I don’t have the mind to fathom just what this is," Alina sighed.
"Hello, everyone. If you are reading this, then I would like to announce to the entire continent that the Berserker Lava Wolf, one of the five Forest Kings in the Wild Forest, is dead.

Its body, still perfectly intact, is to be auctioned at a starting bid of 800 billion. Attached to the body of the Berserker Lava Wolf is a token that will grant you unhindered access to the calamity zone of the Wild Forest for one month.
Thank you, and may the rich walk away with more power."
The entire auction house turned quiet. Not even a peep was made, considering what had just been read was something nobody saw coming.
In fact, everybody, including Kent, was stunned. The words still hang in the air, with my body trying to even ask anything.
A Forest King is dead, and his body is now being auctioned. That is just too much.
Who killed him?
How did he die?
Was this a natural death?
Just what the hell is going on?

There are so many questions, but the most important one is: who will walk away with this body? In fact, the most important question should be: will the winner of this body even be able to keep it after the auction?
The body is a treasure.
The blood is a treasure.
The bones are treasures.
Basically, everything about the Forest King is a treasure of immense value. So, no matter who buys it, the end will be the same.
People will go after them, and no matter where they hide, they will be found until they are dead and the body is taken from them.
"This is going to be a bit dangerous," Kent said, but he wasn’t looking to lose this body to anyone.
"Do you really have to do this?" Selene asked with a serious expression.
"I have no choice. If I let this chance go, I wouldn’t be able to get this lucky ever again, and protecting you ladies is my priority," Kent said, smiling.
"But we should be the ones protecting you," Unity said, bowing her head. The ladies all shared the same look.
They don’t know why Kent is doing all this, but they know it’s very important to him. However, the odds are just too much to go against.

"You ladies will soon have the power to protect me. Trust me, soon I will be relying on you all. But until then, let me brave the danger and ensure no harm comes to you all." His smile was still playing on his lips.

He has become stronger, but going against sword kings and Pill Saints is not something he can take lightly. But he is also going to have to show some strength if he wants his life to return to normal again.
"I will send you ladies away now. Just go into the pool and relax. It will take a couple of weeks before you see me again, but don’t worry, I will come back to you all."
"It will be like I haven’t even left," Kent smiled and sent them away.
⟪The master should know that just this body is enough to create over five Undeads, each between the Transcendent and Ascension stage.⟫
’Why not create a Forest King instead? That will make things easy for me.’
⟪That, indeed, is true. But do you really want that?⟫
’What is that supposed to mean?’ Kent asked.
⟪Do you know why such a creature was eliminated? Of course, you don’t. But if I am not mistaken, it’s all about power.
Just like how you will be hunted down if you end up buying this body, the moment it’s found out that you have a Forest King as a subordinate, your life will forever be in danger.

I can even see the Forest Kings from the various forests coming after you. And let me tell you, there are more than ten Forest Kings in just this continent alone. So please, let’s preserve your life while you grow your strength.

You must at least become a Sword Sage before taking such a step. Right now, you have a Transcendent undead and a metal doll. Show everyone you are no pushover for they will never learn until a few are dead.⟫
⟪And since you can upgrade your undead later, creating a Forest King wouldn’t be a hassle in the future.⟫
’I see. In that case, I will be buying four more Battle Dolls. The next couple of days or weeks will be dangerous.’
⟪I will make arrangements, master.⟫
"The bidding starts now..."

He has become stronger, but going against sword kings and Pill Saints is not something he can take lightly.
But he is also going to have to show some strength if he wants his life to return to normal again.
"I will send you ladies away now.
Just go into the pool and relax.
It will take a couple of weeks before you see me again, but don’t worry, I will come back to you all."
"It will be like I haven’t even left," Kent smiled and sent them away.
⟪The master should know that just this body is enough to create over five Undeads, each between the Transcendent and Ascension stage.⟫
’Why not create a Forest King instead?
That will make things easy for me.’
⟪That, indeed, is true.
But do you really want that?⟫
’What is that supposed to mean?’ Kent asked.
⟪Do you know why such a creature was eliminated?
Of course, you don’t.
But if I am not mistaken, it’s all about power.
Just like how you will be hunted down if you end up buying this body, the moment it’s found out that you have a Forest King as a subordinate, your life will forever be in danger.
I can even see the Forest Kings from the various forests coming after you.
And let me tell you, there are more than ten Forest Kings in just this continent alone.
So please, let’s preserve your life while you grow your strength.
You must at least become a Sword Sage before taking such a step.
Right now, you have a Transcendent undead and a metal doll.
Show everyone you are no pushover for they will never learn until a few are dead.⟫
⟪And since you can upgrade your undead later, creating a Forest King wouldn’t be a hassle in the future.⟫
’I see.
In that case, I will be buying four more Battle Dolls.
The next couple of days or weeks will be dangerous.’
⟪I will make arrangements, master.⟫
"The bidding starts now..."

chapters.title: Chapter 329: Forest King, Berserker Lava Wolf (2)
paragraphs: "900 Billion," A voice boomed from one of the VIP rooms, showing that it was someone nobody would want to mess with.
However, he wasn’t even done when another Voice spoke.
"990 Billion"
"1 trillion"
"1.2 Trillion". Sword King Shawn placed his bid.
"1.4 Trillion." The wicked Poison Witch, for the first time since the auction started, also joined.
"1.7 Trillion" Pill Saint Barton, the same pill saint that Kent bought the Venom from placed his bid.
In fact, now that the wicked poison witch is around, people start to wonder why she didn’t bid on the Poison Sac.
But the bidding grew, and more started adding their voices. It was like some of them had prior notice that such an item would be sold, so they were throwing in their bids like hungry lions.
Suddenly, somebody who was not the sword king, the pill saint, or the wicked Poison witch spoke.
"Brat, what is your name again...Yes, Kent. Why are you quiet. Are you out of cash after spending it on stupid stuff?" The voice contains malice, and it’s full of mocking.
It was basically calling for Kent to respond and perhaps, things will escalate from there.
The moment the voice spoke, no new bid came.
People were trying to see if they recognized that name, but even half a minute late, nobody said anything until Sword King Shawn spoke.
"Evil Bat, what are you doing here?" His question was simple, but an intense hatred could be sensed behind his words.
In fact, aside from his hatred, the sudden mention of the name ’Evil Bat’ made many breaks into a cold sweat.
"Old Shawn, I heard your disciple wandered into my territory a couple of years ago but couldn’t come out in one piece. Although it’s been a couple of years, I would like to offer my condolences."
The voice spoke again, and the laughter that followed made the sword King’s eyes shine with intense bloodlust.
His sword intent and Sword Qi threaten to gush out. But he held himself back because that would be a grave disaster.
"Wait...Evil Bat. Is that the sect master of the Evil sect?" Somebody asked, and like a plague had fallen over the place, people turned pale. The name is like a disease to many.
"Wait, that cannot be him, right? The Evil Sect doesn’t come around these places. The last time they were here was when they attacked the Everlasting Immortal Sword Sect.
What is he doing here, and more importantly, why is he targeting the brat?"
"I think this time, the danger that has fallen on the brat is not one he can be arrogant about. The stakes have risen."
"Evil Bat, you are not welcome here," Sword King Shawn said in a tone commanding his rank as a sword King.
"Indeed. Go back to when you came from before things turn bad for you" Pill Saint Barton said.

"Hahaha," He laughed in a rather sick tone, "the last time I checked, this auction is open to everyone and since you cannot threaten me, I have equal right to be here. Unless the auction is going against their own words."
Everyone became quiet. Indeed, the auction is open to everyone, and since he came with an invitation, he was allowed entry.
"And before you all think you have what it took to come against me, you might want to first become Root Soverigns...Hahahaha"
The faces of all the big shots inside the auctioned house turn grim. The Evil Bat is now a Root Sovereign, just a stage away from becoming a Kingdom Protector or a Forest King.
That is just something they cannot go against.
Just like that, although they hated the evil practitioner, they were forced to back down.
Meanwhile, a Quest message appeared before Kent, but he brushed it aside for the moment it was revealed that the voice was from an evil practitioner; something in him snapped.
"Tsk, to think a mere nobody portraying as a Root Soverign can be arrogant in front of me. When have your wings grown to that level Bat?" Kent asked in a voice filled with disdain.
"Gasp"
This was the reaction that echoed in the auction house. Even the evil bat gasped, for he never expected someone like Kent to make such a comment.
"You came look for trouble with me so what, you can fluent your stolen wealth...Hahaha. I don’t blame you. It’s the fault of the seniors in the kingdoms that allowed you to grow to this stage.
But I will make you a promise today. You will die whether you come after me or not. And I will be taking the body of the Lava wolf with me.
So please, do your worst, and please, be sure to try your best for your ending is neigh."
Kent’s words were spoken like a true man. This made some of the seniors bend their heads in shame.
The bat came to intimidate them, and he succeeded, yet a mere brat who hadn’t even reached the Root Great Sage stage yet just shut him up.
That is just bold.
But Kent wasn’t done.

"I know some of you seniors were planning to go after the one who will end up buying the Lava wolf body. I will be buying it, and so I ask the seniors not to come after me, for I have an offer none of you can reject."
Kent turned toward VIP room 1.

"Please Kingdom Protector, I know you don’t deal with minimal things like this, but I want to leave something in your care," Kent spoke, showing he knew the kingdom protector who appeared the second day was still around.
Unlike most, Ingrid was able to see everyone, and she was the one who told him the kingdom protector was around and in VIP room 1
As expected, a figure suddenly appeared on the stage with her face covered with a dark veil.
Kent also vanished from his booth and appeared on the stage. He extended a space ring to the lady.

"Inside this ring are 100 Golden grade Spirit Enlightenment Fruits. Three weeks from now, all those inside this auction house, between the Root Transcendent and Ascendent who don’t come after me, will receive One.
I am saying this and will only say it once: Those who will come after will die regardless of your cultivation base.
This time, I want to see how arrogant a bat can be"
Kent turned toward the box housing the body of the Lava wolf.
"I bid 20 Trillion for the body. If the bat has the spine, he can place his own bid." Kent vanished and appeared again inside his both.
A lot has happened that even the Kingdom Protector was taken aback.
"Since there are no more bids, the body of the Forest King is sold to the gentleman in VIP room 13." The moment Alina announced the sale of the last item, the bat burst into a resounding laughter.
"Hahahaha...This is good brat. I will make sure your life is filled with pain from now onwards"
"You can try, but what can a mere bat do..." Kent burst into a mocking laughter, the kind that came from the heart.
"We shall see." The bat vanished from the auction house. Kent has just picked a fight with the Evil Sect, the rest will depend on what the dragon can do in the coming days.

chapters.title: Chapter 330: Kent Vs The Evil Sect & Others (1)
paragraphs: ⟪This is it, Master; you have officially pissed off a lot of powerful people. However, you have also set the stage to add more powerful bodies to your next set of undead.
This means you should finally man up and use your strength.
Now, I can’t tell you how many will come after the Forest King Body, but I can assure you that if you manage to bring back Transcendent bodies, you will be walking away with some powerful undead.⟫
Akira said to Kent, who was now sitting alone in VIP room 13. With the auction over, all that was left was for him to go pay for the items he had bought, as well as the ones his women had purchased.
Since they are now inside the tower, he will have to handle that for them. The dangers surrounding him are just too much.
So staying inside the auction house at the moment was good.
However, the moment he stepped out of the auction house and into the open, his life would be in danger. Not that he cares about that.
For the first time, Kent was not going to hide inside the tower, as the quest he had received was too good for him to reject.
’Don’t worry, Akira, I have no plans to run. Since they want to die so badly, I will wait for them to come. I have already prepared for such an outcome so they can come
⟪Good luck, Master. You have many angels waiting for you in the tower.⟫
’I won’t die, Akira. Just take care of the items. In total, I should have between five to seven undead waiting to be created. I will be sure to bring the bodies to start the process.’
After saying that, Kent stood up and left to claim his items.
Along the way, he met the gaze of many hungry lions and even felt the murderous intent coming from afar. They all want a piece of him and their claws on his treasure.
He simply shrugged them off and moved toward the room where he would be claiming all the items he had purchased.
"Hello, Mr. Kent. Please, Lady Alina would like to have a word with you," the lady responsible for taking the money and handing over the items said to him as soon as he entered the room.
"Show me the way," Kent said with a smile.
He was led into a different room where he now stood face to face with his woman, who was playing the role of a stranger to avoid raising suspicion.
Kent could tell someone was watching this interaction, so despite the allure of getting closer to her, he held back.
"Mr. Kent, on behalf of the Silver Leaf Auction House, I would like to thank you for making this year’s auction a memorable one," Alina said with a slight smile.
"I don’t know about memorable, considering half of them want me dead, but I will admit I enjoyed this auction more than I had hoped," Kent replied, shaking his head.
"All the same, someone with your wealth wouldn’t be a pushover. So thank you for making us have a successful auction" Alina gave a cheeky smile before turning serious.
"I asked you here because I learned you have an Ambrosia Apple, and I would like to buy some. And before you ask, yes, I am buying it for someone who, for reasons unknown, couldn’t come herself."
"I see. Though I have one, I would like to point out that it’s not cheap, meaning it’s going to cost you," Kent said in a tone Alina understood all too well.
The payment would indeed involve a lot of pleasurable noises and perfect positions. The undead have mercy on who this mysterious buyer is.
"We will pay whatever amount you have in mind, provided we get the apple in the end." Alina smiled politely, but inwardly, she was imagining scenes where her boss was screaming Kent’s name.
"Since I will be dealing with some idiots after this, why don’t I leave it with you then? You can give it to whoever this person is.
Just tell them that if they want to know the price, they should meet me a day before the start of the Pill Master Competition at the Evermore Restaurant for lunch.
I will tell them the price by then. But of course, they can use the apple, considering keeping it exposed for too long will lower its potency."
Kent took out a jade box housing the apple and handed it to Alina.
"Thank you for your generosity, Mr. Kent," Alina said.
"I will be on my way then," he said before walking away, making sure the one watching from the shadows didn’t suspect anything.
He returned, paid the trillions of spirit stones, collected everything, and stored the items inside his tower storage before leaving.
He went straight to Uncle Drew, who was waiting for him and ready to take him away from Vastport City. They wouldn’t be returning to the sect, as he wasn’t planning to go back there just yet.
The next time he appears in the sect, he will feared by many. He will make sure of that.
"Where to, young master?" Uncle Drew asked.
"Take me to Caprath City, then you can go back and handle your business. I will deal with the rest on my own."
"But young master..."

"Don’t worry, Uncle Drew. I’ve been training for a long time, and I need this exercise. More bodies mean more challenges, so the faster you get your business done in the underworld and hell, the faster we can rescue the two ladies."
Uncle Drew was skeptical about leaving his young master. However, Kent wasn’t about to allow him to stay, considering he still hadn’t fully recovered from the night hunting.

He also has to get to the underworld and take the souls to be used for his Hell Demon project. This is the only way he can help him now, and Kent, who knew this, wasn’t about to allow him to delay that.
"I will take you there, master."
Kent nodded, and then they left. They could already sense people following them and others hiding, but Kent was already planning how best to welcome them.
Meanwhile, three figures could now be seen standing in front of 20 Root Great Stage cultivators. They all wore frowns on their faces, and from the look of things, they were ready for a massacre.
"Move out. According to the tracker following that brat, he is headed toward Caprath City. We must catch up to him before the others get to him.
Remember, your job is to kill him. We will handle whatever hidden trump cards he has up his sleeves."
"Yes, Saints," the 20 replied. They were the strike force sent after Kent.
The three Metal Saints, who hadn’t managed to secure anything tangible in this year’s auction, were now prepared to go after Kent with the intent to kill him and take his items.
And it wasn’t just them.

The Bat, who had come after him due to his wealth, had also started making his moves. The next few hours, depending on how Kent handled it, would see Kent trying to survive the onslaught from multiple angles.

chapters.title: Chapter 331: Kent Vs The Evil Sect & Others (2)
paragraphs: "Your task is to kill and loot him," the Evil Bat said to three masked individuals, each exuding an aura of evil. These people are elders from the evil sect.

The evil sect is a group of practitioners who use nefarious means to obtain power and wealth. Just like the sect master of the divine palace sect, they use other cultivators as their battery for strength.
Anything immoral has their name on it.
They are now being mobilized to go after Kent, who had already left Vastport City and is headed toward the place he was sent when he first appeared in the world of Sonox.
Right now, Kent, who has not only shown he is someone of considerable wealth but also someone who doesn’t fear the strong, has become their next target.
"What are we to do if one of those Sword Kings or Pill Saints were to intervene?" one of them asked in a torturous tone.

"Wouldn’t that be nice? If they do, it will give me an excuse to intervene and kill them. I know they will be around, but since going against such a brat would leave me vulnerable, I can’t give them any chance to launch a sneak attack.
So, if they attack, do your best to retreat. When that happens, I can attack them, and that will be in our favour, considering what we are hiding from everyone is now ready."
"We will not fail you, Bat King," all three said.
"You will not, for failure is not what you all should look forward to," he laughed before bursting into thousands of bats and flying away.
If they fail, they will die. So, in other words, they should fight for the bitter end.
The three also turned to smoke and vanished.
Meanwhile, Kent was now standing atop a small peak, overlooking the large expanse of land stretching before him. The place was where Vexthra sent him after leaving the god realm.
The hideout of the shameless alchemist.
He was alone, having let Uncle Drew enter the tower and then descend into the underworld from there.
"Hmm, a very nice weather for a good slaughter," Kent muttered. "Why is my blood boiling despite knowing the odds coming are not something I can joke around with?"
For some reason, he felt like this was something he should have done many times before.
He was feeling so energetic that he could almost sense the metallic stench of blood on his face. He could feel his sword slicing through their bodies.
Their painful screams echo in his mind. The feeling was almost euphoric.
⟪I believe what the master is feeling is the chaos you are made of. Your bloodline is the Primordial Chaos Dragon.
This means you crave chaos, and from the look of things, despite the odds stacked against you, instead of feeling fear, you only sense the chaos in the air and deep in your blood.
You crave the chaos, and since it’s on the way, your blood is already reacting to it.⟫
"Does this mean I won’t feel fear?" Kent asked.
⟪To some extent, yes, you will feel fear, but it will never overpower your will, which, in this aspect, is driven by the chaos of your bloodline.
So, in battle, no matter the odds, your fear can never overpower your will to keep fighting.⟫
"I see. I guess this is good," Kent said to himself before looking toward his left.
A small smile appeared on his lips. The guest he was waiting for had arrived, and they came in their numbers.
He took a deep sigh and spoke.
"So, you could not live with your own failure. Where did that bring you? Right back to me." He extended his hand, and the ground sword sheath housing his sword appeared.
"I thought by wiping out the bugs you sent after me, you would learn some sense and finally accept your failure. But it seems as long as you three are alive, there will never be peace between us."
"Shut up, brat!" Metal Saint Andrew shouted, pointing a spear at Kent. He hates the brat to the core, so hearing him speak was just too triggering.
"I know what I am going to do," Kent smirked. He was rather calm for someone about to face death.
"I am going to kill you all, and then, using your bodies, I will create monsters that will help me take over this continent, and then the next, and then the entire world.
Be grateful, for, after today, your puny lives will be put to good use."
Kent’s smile vanished, and a mask that covered his eyes down to his nose appeared on his face.
At the same time, 20 Root Great Sages lunged at him from all sides, aiming to finish him before the battle even began.
Kent didn’t make any move. He just stood there, waiting for them to close in. His sword was still in the sheath but could be drawn at any moment.

The moment they came within a meter of him, Kent’s sword flashed from its sheath. With a swing that appeared to happen only once, strings of sword Qi flashed out, cutting all twenty Great Sages in half.
His sword was back in its sheath as if it had never left.
The swing was instantaneous, yet the result spoke for itself: Kent had killed the twenty Great Sages with a single attack, and all who were watching from afar held shocked expressions.
The evidence lay on the ground, and the three Metal Saints, who had been planning to face whoever might come after their loot once their minions dealt with the brat, were now left stunned.
Kent glanced in their direction, but before he could make a move against them, a sword light flashed from behind him, forcing him to dodge.
When he turned around, he saw a Sword Sage, who was also a Root Transcendent, looking back at him.
Then he glanced to his right, and two more people appeared.
Before long, he was surrounded on all sides, with only four Root Great Sages in the mix. The rest were all Root Transcendents, including even a Pill Saint.
"So, you all rejected my offer and got greedy, huh?" Kent said with a smirk.
"Although the Spirit Enlightenment Fruit is indeed good for Transcendents and beyond, the body of a Forest King is much more valuable.
I hope you don’t take this the wrong way, but if you were to give it to me, I will protect you from all these people."
Pill Saint Enex spoke like the righteous hypocrite he was. They all wanted to get their hands on the Forest King’s body, so of course, they would do anything in their power to obtain it.
Kent looked around and sighed.
"You all don’t seem to understand. I am not asking you to choose the Spirit Enlightenment Fruits. No, I merely offered those who wanted to live to you.
But since we are here now, you can all die." Kent took a cylindrical-shaped item and injected his energy into it.
"Battle Space: Activate."
Immediately after, he said that all 40 people surrounding him were sucked into the battle space along with him.
On the inside, the sky shook as a terrifying being appeared. His body was bathed in lightning as a storm formed in the sky.

The evil sect is a group of practitioners who use nefarious means to obtain power and wealth.
Just like the sect master of the divine palace sect, they use other cultivators as their battery for strength.
Anything immoral has their name on it.

chapters.title: Chapter 332: Kent Vs The Evil Sect & Others (3)
paragraphs: Kaizo, Kent’s first undead, is a monstrosity of a man. The saying "I am built differently" is taken from him. He is a terrifying sight to behold. A being built differently.
Kaizo is a towering warrior with a muscular physique, his body sculpted like steel. Just looking at him is enough to tell that swords and pointy items won’t have much effect on him.
He has long black hair that looks as though it is standing on its own in groups. Some strands fall behind him, but just looking at his hair shows his strong affinity for the lightning element.

He wears a dark, sleeveless martial gi with a thick, tattered belt tied around his waist. His wrists are wrapped with glowing blue bands, crackling with electricity. His lower attire consists of flowing dark pants.
The moment Kent sent everyone into the battle space he planned to use during the rescue mission, he summoned his first undead, Kaizo.

The attackers, now feeling the pressure emanating from him, broke into a cold sweat. The battle space is just like the outside world, with the laws and everything thing working the same as the outside world.
The only difference was that Kent could send out and pull in people.
He appeared beside his undead and looked down at the people who were still lost about where they were.
"Let’s end this quickly. There are still targets waiting for us on the outside," Kent said, and Kaizo nodded.
He cracked his knuckles and turned his neck sideways, creating a cracking sound. That alone broke the confidence of many.
Kaizo smiled down at the 40 figures Kent managed to pull inside the battle space. The smile didn’t reach his eyes.
This alone made most of them break into more sweat.
"First Kill", he muttered.
He then pointed at a Root Transcendent holding a spear. At once, a lightning bolt shot from his fingers, drilling a hole through the man’s forehead.
"It worked, huh? Then why don’t we start with a clap?" Kaizo moved and appeared in the middle of a group of eight Root Transcendents.
"Thunderclap!" He clapped his hands together, and lightning burst out, knocking four away and killing four on the spot.
"This will be fun," Kaizo laughed, and then he jumped toward a Root Transcendent who was holding a sword. His fist crackled with lightning as it descended on the poor bastard.

"On second thought, take your time, Kaizo," Kent smiled behind his mask and waved his hand. At once, five powerful Battle Dolls, each at the peak of the Root Great Sage stage, appeared and jumped into action.
"You three are mine," he said, turning toward the Three Metal Saints, and then he vanished.
The next second, his sword left its sheath and aimed at Metal Saint Andrew, who was caught off guard by the sudden disappearance and reappearance of the brat.
Kent’s sword came close to severing his neck, but he had to dodge to the side when an attack came from Metal Saint Rocky, who was wearing a gauntlet.
Kent moved back a few meters before stabilizing himself. The Rocky was named after his build and fighting style.
He is a brute, and the shockwave from his punch said it all. The bastard is powerful. He was pushed back and tried to stabilise himself.
However, he isn’t even done when Metal Saint Adolf appears behind him, aiming his sword with the intent of stabbing him in the back.
However, Kent blinked away, leaving nothing behind.
Adolf’s sword struck the air.
Kent appeared behind one of the Root Great Sages still present, and before this unfortunate soul could realize what had happened, his head came rolling down.
Kent blinked away again, and when he was within range of another Root Great Sage, he attacked, and that head, too, was on the ground the next second.
The three Root Transcendents who witnessed this frowned.
This was a huge disrespect to them. Not only did a junior disregard their presence and kill two people right under their noses, but he also did it in a way they couldn’t comprehend.
Kent was teleporting between attacks, and from their perspective, he could do it continuously for who knows how long.
Kent went ahead and dispatched the last of the Root Great Sages, whose bodies vanished the moment they fell.
When he was done, he turned toward the three Metal Saints and swung his sword at Metal Saint Rocky.
"72 Sovereign Weaving Strike!"
The 72 chains with pointed tips aimed at Rocky. They moved swiftly through the air, but when they were a few meters from him, they split up, catching Andrew and Adolf off-guard.
Naturally, they all raised their defences.

Rocky crossed his arms in an X shape, creating a forcefield around him. Andrew stabbed his spear into the ground, also creating a defence. As for Adolf, he took a large swing, sending a sword arc to counter the chains.
They each mounted their defences, but that was exactly what Kent was after.
"Rapid Slash!"
His sword flashed forward, and 300 sword arcs appeared in the air.
"What?!" Rocky shouted, trying to mount another defence, but he was a step too late. All 300 sword arcs rained down on him alone, sending him flying.
Kent blinked away and appeared kilometres away, where, by his calculation, the Metal Saint would land. However, instead of activating another attack, Kent took out an item and threw it at him.
It was a fist-sized ball. He threw it at the brute, and when it landed on his body, it exploded.
"Aaarrrggghhh!"
A painful cry escaped the Metal Saint’s lips as his body slammed into the ground with a heavy thud.
All over his body, metal spikes in the form of nails could be seen embedded, causing blood to pump from every wound.
He rolled on the ground, screaming as the nails, imbued with a poison designed to amplify pain, began to invade his body.
The agony would only continue to increase as long as he remained alive. So he kept screaming his heart out on the ground, bringing a smile to Kent’s face.
"You will suffer before dying," Kent said coldly.
Kent didn’t even turn to face him. Instead, he dodged to the side, evading a spear thrust that could have killed him.
"No, you won’t," Kent muttered, realizing Metal Saint Andrew had intended to save his partner on the ground.
In an instant, Kent blinked and appeared beside the screaming body of the Root Transcendent, who was in that situation mainly because he had been caught off-guard by Kent’s careful planning.
The three are Transcendents, so killing them without tricks should be something Kent would entertain when dozens of Transcendents surround him.
"Kaizo!" Kent called out.
At that moment, a powerful kick landed on the body of the Metal Saint, sending him flying toward the menacing Kaizo, who was effortlessly wasting away the lives of those attacking him.
Kaizo, who needed no verbal command, clapped his hands, and thunder rumbled inside the battle space.
Then, as if commanding a bolt of lightning, a massive bolt struck Metal Saint Rocky’s chest, drilling a hole straight through him.
"One down, two more to go," Kent grinned behind his mask. He had killed one and was ready to kill the two left.
However, before he could move to attack them, his body froze as an arrow appeared in front of him, speeding toward his chest.

chapters.title: Chapter 333: Kent Vs The Evil Sect & Others (4) {Gift Bonus Chapter}
paragraphs: "That was close," Kent, who narrowly evaded the arrow, looked toward his right. Up in the air was a cloaked figure aiming another arrow at him.
The cloaked figure is another Transcendent trying to kill him, just like everyone. So Kent didn’t even bother appraising him.
He quickly moved away but was stopped by the Metal Saint Adolf, who slashed his sword, sending a powerful sword arc toward him.
Kent countered with his own sword arc, but before he could get back into action, another arrow arrived in front of him.
He blinked away, but the next second, Metal Saint Andrew’s spear was upon him. It was a perfectly coordinated strike from the three, but Kent knew it was just a coincidence.
However, he cannot underestimate them.

’Damn, fighting Root Transcendents is no joke,’ Kent thought inwardly, jumping into the air to evade a powerful swing from the spearman, who was determined to kill the brat that had slain one of them.
"Die, brat!" Metal Saint Andrew shouted.

His spear multiplied into dozens as he stabbed forward, sending all of them toward Kent, who swung his sword, creating hundreds of sword arcs that decimated the spears and rained down on the spearman.
"Ouch!" Kent was sent flying when an arrow landed on his shoulder. He rolled on the ground for a few seconds, considering the force behind the arrow was just too much for his strength level.
The archer, moving through the air, flashed forward with a short sword, ready to end the battle. Kent, who was on the ground, smirked, watching him close in.
However, just as he was a meter away, a pointed dark shard shot up from the ground, piercing his chest and killing him instantly.
Kent used the [Doom Shard] skill he received when he added Alina to the harem and it worked like he expected.
It is a perfect sneak attack skill.
It was one powerful skill that allowed him to conjure shards made from black diamonds. The durability alone said it all.
It went through his chest like it was nothing.
"Punk," Kent spat blood on the ground, feeling the pain from the arrow moving through his shoulder.
⟪You’ve been poisoned, master⟫ Akira’s voice entered his ears as he moved to the side, evading the spear that had appeared in front of his face.
’I know, Akira. I just need a minute to recover,’ Kent said, already jumping between attacks. His bloodline was already working on handling the poison.
He clashed with the metal saints again, who started to take him much more seriously now.
"Skybreaker Fist!"
Kaizo’s voice boomed as his body rose into the air, bathed in lightning. His fist was clenched, and all around it, a metal coating crackled with lightning.
He ascended until he was 20 meters above the ground. Then he descended, and the next second, his powerful fist slammed into the ground, throwing everyone into the air.
The Metal Dolls, who were in the air when this fist landed, moved, and the next second, dozens of Transcendents were killed.
"Sorry, Master. I didn’t know that attack would be that dangerous," Kaizo said, making Kent smirk.
Kent’s sword swung forward, and 400 sword arcs rained down on Metal Saint Adolf, who tried to defend against all of them but simply couldn’t.
The only way to defend against that was to cover their bodies with something the sword arcs could not cut.

The defence Adolf raised was destroyed, and his left arm was severed from his body. The moment that happened, Kent moved in for the kill, but Metal Saint Andrew spoke before his sword could pierce his chest.
"Brat, don’t kill him. If you do, you will never know peace ever again," his words were desperate yet arrogant.
"Okay," Kent said, and then stabbed Adolf through the heart, ending him.
"A wise man once said, ’I hate peace; I want problems, always,’" he smiled and then looked at Andrew. "Now, prepare to die, for that is the only way out for you."
The Metal Saint held a grim look on his face.
"Then we can die together," he said, taking a dark pill from his space ring and swallowing it. The moment he did, his eyes turned dark, and he coughed up blood.
"Blood Possession Pill... What an idiot," Kent muttered, but he wasn’t smiling.
"Kaizo, end the battle in the next five minutes," he shouted, and the undead brute nodded.
He cracked his knuckles, and the rest was devastation for the pitiful Transcendents who were utterly useless in front of the brute whose skin was just too thick against their weapons.
"Kaizo, use your domain skill," Kent ordered, sensing something was amiss. He gave the command to protect his life and that of his undead.
"Lightning Domain," Kaizo obeyed and activated the skill, immediately creating a domain around him and the eight pitiful Transcendents now pleading for their lives.
The Dolls were also handling the last of the six Transcendents they had targeted.
On the other hand, Kent was being bombarded by attacks only a Root Ascendant could unleash.
The pill Metal Saint Andrew took raises one’s strength to the next stage for a limited time. Five minutes in most cases.
This meant that he had entered the Root Ascendant stage for the next five minutes. After five minutes, he would self-destruct, and the results would be devastating.
Of course, Kent took all of this into perspective, so he was managing the attacks until Kaizo and the Dolls were done.
"Die, brat!" The possessed Metal Saint shouted.
A dark beam shot from his spear, but Kent cut it in half and countered with his own attack, sending 400 sword arcs at him.
However, they were all neutralized by a dark cocoon created by Metal Saint Andrew, who was coughing blood with every passing second.
"60 seconds more," Kent muttered as he evaded an attack from the now-dying Metal Saint, who was filled with regret at that moment.
He regretted ever coming against such a brat. He regretted not walking away when he was met with the first obstacle.
He regretted not having the chance to stab his sword through Kent’s chest. He regretted many things.
Now, it was ending, and he could only wallow in regret as the seconds ticked down.
Kaizo held the last Transcendent by the neck as his lightning burned through him, separating the head from the body.
The battle dolls had also finished off the six they were dealing with, each bathed in blood like their master and Kaizo, their teammate, who looked like a disaster in humanoid form.
"20 seconds," Kent counted as he kept evading the attacks. The Metal Saint had injured him in a few places, but Kent was healing much faster than he was losing blood.
In fact, whenever he was cut, his healing instantly sealed his wounds, making them appear as if they had never been inflicted. Of course, deeper wounds were different.
"5 seconds," Kent counted down as he blocked a spear thrust aimed at his chest. His leg moved, landing on Metal Saint Andrew’s face and sending him flying.
"4 seconds."
"3 seconds."
When a second remained, He snapped his fingers, and the Metal Saint vanished. The next second, he was on the outside.
Then, a painful scream escaped his mouth.
At the same time, his body expanded, and then—*boom*—he exploded, decimating the two-mile radius.

"Ouch!" Kent was sent flying when an arrow landed on his shoulder.
He rolled on the ground for a few seconds, considering the force behind the arrow was just too much for his strength level.
The archer, moving through the air, flashed forward with a short sword, ready to end the battle.
Kent, who was on the ground, smirked, watching him close in.
However, just as he was a meter away, a pointed dark shard shot up from the ground, piercing his chest and killing him instantly.
Kent used the [Doom Shard] skill he received when he added Alina to the harem and it worked like he expected.
It is a perfect sneak attack skill.
It was one powerful skill that allowed him to conjure shards made from black diamonds.
The durability alone said it all.
It went through his chest like it was nothing.
"Punk," Kent spat blood on the ground, feeling the pain from the arrow moving through his shoulder.
⟪You’ve been poisoned, master⟫ Akira’s voice entered his ears as he moved to the side, evading the spear that had appeared in front of his face.
’I know, Akira.
I just need a minute to recover,’ Kent said, already jumping between attacks.
His bloodline was already working on handling the poison.
He clashed with the metal saints again, who started to take him much more seriously now.
"Skybreaker Fist!"
Kaizo’s voice boomed as his body rose into the air, bathed in lightning.
His fist was clenched, and all around it, a metal coating crackled with lightning.
He ascended until he was 20 meters above the ground.
Then he descended, and the next second, his powerful fist slammed into the ground, throwing everyone into the air.
The Metal Dolls, who were in the air when this fist landed, moved, and the next second, dozens of Transcendents were killed.
"Sorry, Master.
I didn’t know that attack would be that dangerous," Kaizo said, making Kent smirk.
Kent’s sword swung forward, and 400 sword arcs rained down on Metal Saint Adolf, who tried to defend against all of them but simply couldn’t.
The only way to defend against that was to cover their bodies with something the sword arcs could not cut.
The defence Adolf raised was destroyed, and his left arm was severed from his body.
The moment that happened, Kent moved in for the kill, but Metal Saint Andrew spoke before his sword could pierce his chest.
"Brat, don’t kill him.
If you do, you will never know peace ever again," his words were desperate yet arrogant.
"Okay," Kent said, and then stabbed Adolf through the heart, ending him.
"A wise man once said, ’I hate peace; I want problems, always,’" he smiled and then looked at Andrew.
"Now, prepare to die, for that is the only way out for you."
The Metal Saint held a grim look on his face.
"Then we can die together," he said, taking a dark pill from his space ring and swallowing it.
The moment he did, his eyes turned dark, and he coughed up blood.
"Blood Possession Pill...
What an idiot," Kent muttered, but he wasn’t smiling.
"Kaizo, end the battle in the next five minutes," he shouted, and the undead brute nodded.
He cracked his knuckles, and the rest was devastation for the pitiful Transcendents who were utterly useless in front of the brute whose skin was just too thick against their weapons.
"Kaizo, use your domain skill," Kent ordered, sensing something was amiss.
He gave the command to protect his life and that of his undead.
"Lightning Domain," Kaizo obeyed and activated the skill, immediately creating a domain around him and the eight pitiful Transcendents now pleading for their lives.
The Dolls were also handling the last of the six Transcendents they had targeted.
On the other hand, Kent was being bombarded by attacks only a Root Ascendant could unleash.
The pill Metal Saint Andrew took raises one’s strength to the next stage for a limited time.
Five minutes in most cases.
This meant that he had entered the Root Ascendant stage for the next five minutes.
After five minutes, he would self-destruct, and the results would be devastating.
Of course, Kent took all of this into perspective, so he was managing the attacks until Kaizo and the Dolls were done.
"Die, brat!" The possessed Metal Saint shouted.
A dark beam shot from his spear, but Kent cut it in half and countered with his own attack, sending 400 sword arcs at him.
However, they were all neutralized by a dark cocoon created by Metal Saint Andrew, who was coughing blood with every passing second.
"60 seconds more," Kent muttered as he evaded an attack from the now-dying Metal Saint, who was filled with regret at that moment.
He regretted ever coming against such a brat.
He regretted not walking away when he was met with the first obstacle.
He regretted not having the chance to stab his sword through Kent’s chest.
He regretted many things.
Now, it was ending, and he could only wallow in regret as the seconds ticked down.
Kaizo held the last Transcendent by the neck as his lightning burned through him, separating the head from the body.
The battle dolls had also finished off the six they were dealing with, each bathed in blood like their master and Kaizo, their teammate, who looked like a disaster in humanoid form.
"20 seconds," Kent counted as he kept evading the attacks.
The Metal Saint had injured him in a few places, but Kent was healing much faster than he was losing blood.
In fact, whenever he was cut, his healing instantly sealed his wounds, making them appear as if they had never been inflicted.
Of course, deeper wounds were different.
"5 seconds," Kent counted down as he blocked a spear thrust aimed at his chest.
His leg moved, landing on Metal Saint Andrew’s face and sending him flying.
"4 seconds."
"3 seconds."
When a second remained, He snapped his fingers, and the Metal Saint vanished.
The next second, he was on the outside.
Then, a painful scream escaped his mouth.
At the same time, his body expanded, and then—*boom*—he exploded, decimating the two-mile radius.

chapters.title: Chapter 334: Kent Vs The Evil Sect & Others (5) {Gift Bonus Chapter}
paragraphs: 45 minutes ago, when Kent was surrounded, those hiding began sharpening their weapons, waiting for a chance to take what they came for.
Then Kent, along with everyone else, vanished, leaving in their place a cylindrical disk. This shocked them all.
They were hiding to take advantage of when he was down, but instead of that happening, everyone vanished.
Twenty minutes later, they still had not returned. Of course, these hidden figures began emerging with the intent of seizing the disc hovering in the air.
They knew Kent was inside, so the moment they got their hands on it, they would be able to trap him the moment he got out.
However, that didn’t go as planned.
The first person who tried taking the disc was thrown across the air like a ragdoll. There was a forcefield around it, making it impossible to take.
This meant Kent could only be captured and killed the moment he got out of the space he entered with the dozens of transcendent.
That is if he came out alive. If he was dead, the one that would come out would become their target.
And so, many began to gather, with a few Root Ascension stage experts disguised as Transcendents also within grabbing range of the disc, unaware that something good was on its way.
Well, it’s bad for them but good for Kent.
His initial plan was to send out the five Battle Dolls first, and then Kaizo would follow. This would give him a chance to assess the situation and deal with it accordingly.
He was stupid to think only the 4 dozen people he took with him were the only ones coming after him. So, he was making plans for what would happen next.
However, the moment Metal Saint Andrew took the blood possession pill, things changed for him.

And so, Kent waited and kept counting until the seconds reached the ticking point. That was when a figure appeared in the midst of the over a hundred people around the disc and those hiding closer to it.
The moment Metal Saint Andrew appeared, people dashed toward him, but they came to a halt when a painful cry escaped his lips.
That was when they recognised him and also realised something was wrong.
"Everyone, run—" The voice didn’t even finish the shout when a powerful explosion rocked the space, killing as many as it could.
Painful screams and those who didn’t even get to scream were the result of Metal Saint Andrew’s self-destruction.
In a way, he got his wish. He didn’t die alone.
The result said it all. The two-mile radius was decimated, and dozens of Root Great Sages and Transcendents died.
Dozens more were injured, with even a few Ascendants harmed. This was a surprise attack, and they fell for it.
"Kill them all." Suddenly, a familiar voice entered their ears, forcing those who could look to turn toward the direction it came from.
There, standing in the air, was Kent, who pointed his sword forward as five metallic figures moved with the wind.
In the next moments, people began dying, with even two unfortunate Root Ascension stage experts falling prey to Kent’s perfect attack plan.
The metal dolls were perfect for killing, for they didn’t make mistakes when it came to aiming for the lives of those they were facing.
"Hahahahah!"
Suddenly, a sinister laughter echoed through the air, accompanied by a bone chain.
It shot toward Kent with the intent to stab him through the heart, but before it could get within two meters of him, a hand grabbed it and pulled forward, sending the attacker flying toward him.
"Pick someone your own size," Kaizo said, landing a powerful punch on the person’s face and breaking the mask in half.
A bony face was revealed.
"You ugly bro... I’m going to enjoy smashing your face." Kaizo said before he moved, and the clash between him and the Level 3 Root Ascension Elder from the Evil Sect began.
"Die, brat." Kent, of course, knew he was just about to start the real battle, so he was ready when the voice came and a dagger appeared before him.
Instead of dodging, he moved forward and kicked forward instead, sending an invisible figure flying.
"Your camouflage won’t work on me, so fight like real men and die like the idiots you are," Kent said, blinking away.
He appeared behind one of the Evil Sect elders, kicked, and aimed another blow at his neck. However, it was blocked, and a dagger came for his neck instead.
But he blinked away again, and then lightning burst out of his body. His aura also skyrocketed, and he moved, showing that his speed had increased as well.
Kent added 13,000 points out of the 23,000 he had to his speed and the rest to his strength and stamina, so the current him was filled with energy.
He moved, leaving afterimages behind.
The trail of lightning flashed its golden hue as he moved at a speed even the peak Transcendents he was fighting couldn’t seem to track.
Stab...
Suddenly, his sword went through the chest of one of the Evil Sect elders, but the elder turned to smoke and vanished. The next time he appeared, blood was coming from his lips.
"You can’t kill me using physical means, brat." A sinister laughter escaped his lips. "Now die."
He moved and stabbed his dagger at Kent. The attack was shifted, but Kent had become much faster, so he dodged.
Both Elders were assassins, but instead of using the element of surprise against him, they were now trying their best to outpace him.
"I know I can’t kill you like that, but I made you look cocky for a moment there," Kent said, blocking his attack and grabbing hold of his arm.
"Soul Shock." Kent activated his soul skill, and for a moment, the figure blacked out as his soul was attacked suddenly.
"Die." That was all the elder heard before his head was severed from his body. "Always go for the head, for it cannot walk without the body", Kent added coldly.
"What?!"
The other elder, who was closing in, retreated when he saw his fellow elder die through physical means.
It shouldn’t have been possible, considering they always turned to smoke whenever a physical attack landed on them.
They were the perfect assassins and also two of the seven darkness-type people all over the human continent.
So how, then, did he die?
He was shocked beyond his senses.
"Behind you," Kent said, and the elder fell for it. He looked back but saw nothing. When he looked forward again, he was now face to face with Kent.
"Peekaboo."
A soul attack landed on his soul as well, and then his head was severed. Kent took both their bodies into his Necro Forge, knowing they were valuable for what he had planned after the battles.
The moment the second elder died, the one fighting Kaizo was smashed to the ground, creating a crater.
"Skybreaker Fist!" the Brute activated his devastating skill again.
Like a meteor, Kaizo descended from the sky, landing a powerful attack on the elder and ending him in the most painful way possible.
*Rumble.*
Thunder and lightning flashed through the sky.
Kaizo rose into the air and stopped beside his master, who was looking into the distance.
The Battle Dolls also moved, stopping behind Kent and creating a protective shield around him.
All around, the only things left were the charred remains of those who had died in the blast. The rest were killed, and their bodies were taken into the Necro Forge.
"Who’s next?" Kent asked, casting a scene that commanded fear. Everyone watching was terrified of him.
He not only have five Battle dolls, he also have a Peak Root Transcendent who can easily kill a level three Root Ascension stage expert.
That is a lot to handle.
"Very well, brat. You can die now..."
Of course, just as some can’t read the room, some can’t see reason.
Bats filled the sky as a figure whom everyone aside from the Kingdom Protectors feared appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 335: Kent Vs Evil Bat {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: Before the end of the auction, Kent received a quest he could not refuse. In fact, it was a quest he felt compelled to accept, no matter the danger involved.
Even without the quest, he was already prepared to confront the Bat with everything he had, as he harboured a deep hatred for evil cultivators.
This feeling arose when he discovered that the sect master of the Divine Palace Sect was an evil practitioner.
This revelation fueled his determination to face the evil Bat, even though he knew that merely drawing its blood would be a significant achievement.
However, most of his resolve stemmed from the quest itself.
⟪Quest Name: The Extermination Quest⟫
⟪Quest Type: Procedural (Your rewards come as the quest progresses)⟫
⟪Quest Difficulty: Very Difficult⟫
→ Every legendary story begins with something incomprehensible.
→ The odds are now stacked against you, and you must face even greater challenges before you can overcome them.
→ The four kingdoms are coming after you, and since they want you dead, you must ensure your survival. This means you must stand firm and fight for your freedom.
→ They will be watching, so send a clear message to them all. In doing so, you will earn rewards beyond your imagination.
⟪Rewards: ⟫
→ Mirror Enemy (Kill three Root Transcendents for this reward)
→ The rest of the rewards will be revealed after the last person is convinced you are not someone they can touch.
This was the quest Kent received, and right now, he doesn’t know how much he will earn from it. But as he watched the Bat appear in the sky ahead, his blood began to boil.
The odds staring down at him were overwhelming, even for someone like him. Yet, instead of fear, he felt anticipation for the battle to come.
He had exhausted all his points by allocating them to Agility, Strength, and Stamina, but he wasn’t at a loss. He still had a few tricks up his sleeve and his sword firmly in his grip.
"You’ve proven stubborn, brat, but since you had the audacity to kill my people, I will have to kill you," the Evil Bat said in a tone that made many who heard it shudder.

"I don’t know if bats are generally stupid, or if you’re one of a kind, but can’t you see I was killing others before they came? Or are you telling me your stupidity has reached the point where reason no longer applies?" Kent retorted, causing the Bat to frown.
The Bat extended its hands, and a swarm of bats flew out, speeding toward Kent. He stood his ground, watching calmly as the bats closed in.
Just as the bats were upon him, lightning bolts blasted them to bits. Kaizo was already on the move, charging at the Bat, who wore a smirk on his face.
Looking at the brute coming at him, the Bat wasn’t sure whether to smile or cry. Kaizo, on the other hand, had already sensed his opponent’s lack of seriousness but didn’t back down.
"Rapid Slash," Kent’s voice echoed in his head, and a smile spread across Kaizo’s face.
"Overdrive." His speed increased, and like a lightning bolt, he appeared in front of the Bat, who was caught off guard.
Kaizo’s fist shot toward the Bat’s face, but before it could land a solid blow, the Bat exploded into a swarm of smaller bats and scattered.
However, not all the bats escaped unscathed. Four hundred and fifty sword arcs decimated their ranks, forcing the Evil Bat to reconsider his strategy and attempt to sneak up on Kent.
Kent, anticipating the move, dashed toward Kaizo and retrieved an item from his space ring. He channelled his energy into it and hurled it into the air.
"Domain!"
The Evil Bat, who was closing in on Kent, sensed his surroundings growing cold. In fact, the area began to freeze, forcing him to retreat once more.
"Why, scared of the cold?" Kent sneered as he slashed his sword, unleashing 450 sword arcs. A frown spread across the Bat’s face.
He just doesn’t want to admit he was now dodging attacks from a mere Root Sage. That can truly be happening, right?
But it was and he could tell from the countless swarm of sword arcs coming at him.
The attack closed in rapidly, forcing him to retreat even faster before the cold could overtake him. Kent was attacking like a madman, and Kaizo was standing idle instead.
As for the Dolls, some were standing guard for any sneak attacks while some were in full-on attack mode.
The bat kept retreating, trying not to get trapped in the Ice, for that was one of his weaknesses. But Kent was also making sure his retreat wouldn’t go smoothly.
Evil bats burst into bats and flew away before forming into humans again.
However, he had to dodge to the side when Kaizo’s fist nearly grazed his face.
In response, he exploded into countless bats again, but as before, Kent unleashed the full power of Rapid Slash, slaughtering the bats in droves.
The battle was a testament to Kent and Kaizo pushing their limits and doing everything in their power to keep the Bat from getting close to Kent.
In fact, after just one minute of combat, it was clear that Kent and Kaizo were no match for the Root Sovereign-stage Bat.
Yet, the fact that they were preventing a Sovereign from reaching Kent was nothing short of monstrous.
"Enough!" the Evil Bat shouted as he was sent flying once again by Kent and his undead companion. This time, he didn’t fly too far. He stopped mid-air and raised his hand.
"Blood Spears!"
Up in the air, thousands of blood-red spears materialized and shot toward Kent.

"Master, get behind me," Kaizo said as he raised his hand, summoning an orb of lightning. He clenched his fist, and the orb exploded into a net of lightning, forming a protective dome around him and Kent.
The blood spears began to pierce through the Lightning Net, forcing Kaizo to pour more energy into maintaining the barrier as they brainstormed their next move.
Kent remained calm, his eyes fixed on the Bat hovering above.
"How can this Bat be killed?" Kaizo asked, glancing back at his master, who, despite the imminent danger, exuded an air of composure.
Kent continued to stare at the Bat for a full minute before letting out a small sigh.
"He’s just too far above our strength level," Kent admitted.
"Then should we escape?" Kaizo asked, ensuring his master understood that his safety was the priority. If they couldn’t kill the Bat, fleeing was their only option.
"No, Kaizo. We won’t be running. This bastard will serve as an example.

I know this is our first time fighting together, but the first rule of combat in my eyes and heart is... we never back down from a good fight. And this," Kent said with a smile, "feels like a good fight."
"In that case, Master, why don’t we beat this bastard until he forgets his mama’s name?" Kaizo replied, a smile spreading across his face as well.
"You said it," Kent agreed.
The brat and his undead companion exchanged determined smiles as Kent’s skin beneath his armour transformed, taking on the scaly texture of a dragon.
"All we need is his blood," Kent said, his voice steady and resolute.

Kent was attacking like a madman, and Kaizo was standing idle instead.
As for the Dolls, some were standing guard for any sneak attacks while some were in full-on attack mode.
The bat kept retreating, trying not to get trapped in the Ice, for that was one of his weaknesses.
But Kent was also making sure his retreat wouldn’t go smoothly.
Evil bats burst into bats and flew away before forming into humans again.
However, he had to dodge to the side when Kaizo’s fist nearly grazed his face.
In response, he exploded into countless bats again, but as before, Kent unleashed the full power of Rapid Slash, slaughtering the bats in droves.
The battle was a testament to Kent and Kaizo pushing their limits and doing everything in their power to keep the Bat from getting close to Kent.
In fact, after just one minute of combat, it was clear that Kent and Kaizo were no match for the Root Sovereign-stage Bat.
Yet, the fact that they were preventing a Sovereign from reaching Kent was nothing short of monstrous.
"Enough!" the Evil Bat shouted as he was sent flying once again by Kent and his undead companion.
This time, he didn’t fly too far.
He stopped mid-air and raised his hand.
"Blood Spears!"
Up in the air, thousands of blood-red spears materialized and shot toward Kent.
"Master, get behind me," Kaizo said as he raised his hand, summoning an orb of lightning.
He clenched his fist, and the orb exploded into a net of lightning, forming a protective dome around him and Kent.
The blood spears began to pierce through the Lightning Net, forcing Kaizo to pour more energy into maintaining the barrier as they brainstormed their next move.
Kent remained calm, his eyes fixed on the Bat hovering above.
"How can this Bat be killed?" Kaizo asked, glancing back at his master, who, despite the imminent danger, exuded an air of composure.
Kent continued to stare at the Bat for a full minute before letting out a small sigh.
"He’s just too far above our strength level," Kent admitted.
"Then should we escape?" Kaizo asked, ensuring his master understood that his safety was the priority.
If they couldn’t kill the Bat, fleeing was their only option.
"No, Kaizo.
We won’t be running.
This bastard will serve as an example.
I know this is our first time fighting together, but the first rule of combat in my eyes and heart is... we never back down from a good fight.
And this," Kent said with a smile, "feels like a good fight."
"In that case, Master, why don’t we beat this bastard until he forgets his mama’s name?" Kaizo replied, a smile spreading across his face as well.
"You said it," Kent agreed.
The brat and his undead companion exchanged determined smiles as Kent’s skin beneath his armour transformed, taking on the scaly texture of a dragon.
"All we need is his blood," Kent said, his voice steady and resolute.

chapters.title: Chapter 336: Just His Blood {Gift Bonus - }
paragraphs: Boom!
A punch landed on Kent’s chest, sending him slamming into the ground like a meteor. His body crashed into the earth, creating a massive crater.
Blood sprayed from his mouth, and his body was covered in cuts that healed at an astonishing speed.
Kent stood up and launched himself back into the air, just as Kaizo exchanged blows with the Bat, who remained unscathed, not a single cut or injury visible.
"The saying ’cut your coat according to your size’ is indeed true," Kent smiled, spitting out blood. "But the saying ’never give up’ is also something worth taking to heart."
He closed in and unleashed a series of rapid slashes, aiming to draw just a single drop of blood from the Bat. That would be enough.
"Thunderclap!" Kaizo clapped his hands together, sending a shockwave through the air. "This wingless bat is troublesome, Master."
"I know, right? For a wingless, spineless bat, why can’t we do anything to it?" Kent said. The two burst into resounding laughter despite their battered state.
They could have used telepathy to communicate, but Kent wanted to keep infuriating the Bat, hoping to push him into making a mistake.
That would be the moment the Bat would realise a mere brat was not to be trifled with.
"I don’t eat bat, but I know someone who does," Kaizo said, blocking a spear aimed at Kent by stepping in front of him.
Kent moved from behind him and activated the [True Despair Sword Strike], landing a powerful attack filled with despair on the Bat, who simply defended against it.
However, the despair in that attack affected him slightly.
"Is this bat-eater someone worth befriending?" Kent asked. He dodged back, evading three blood spears, but one grazed his arm.
"He’s an idiot, but then again, giving him the body of a stupid bat might make him very happy. It could even earn us his help the next time we need it," Kaizo replied.
He launched himself into the air, dashing forward with his right leg aimed at the Bat’s chest.
Kent slashed his sword, unleashing 450 sword arcs that rained down on the Bat. They are doing their best but their opponent is just too monstrous.
"I guess killing him is the only way," Kent muttered.
"Just die, bugs!" the Evil Bat snarled, clearly irritated by their banter.
He unleashed a new attack, creating multiple circles in the air. From these circles, larger bats with crimson wings emerged, swooping down to attack Kent and his annoying undead.
[Keep him occupied, Kaizo. Three of the dolls will help you. Let me and the two dolls handle the bats.]

Kaizo didn’t need to hear Kent’s voice in his head to know what had to be done. They each moved into position, and the battle escalated into a more intense phase, with Kent and Kaizo sustaining injuries.
Even the dolls were taking damage, but Kent refused to back down. Not when he was determined to use the Bat as an example.
Five miles from the battlefield, Sword King Shawn, Pill Saint Barton, and the Wicked Poison Witch watched the unfolding chaos.

"Should this even be possible?" Pill Saint Barton asked, his voice tinged with disbelief. Watching Kent repeatedly rise and re-enter a fight he knew deep down he couldn’t win left Barton at a loss for words.

"I’m as shocked as you are, Barton, but the reality is right before us. The kid is telling everyone he fears no one, and no matter the odds, he won’t back down from a fight," Sword King Shawn said, a smile spreading across his face.
"I’ve only seen this kind of determination once before, about 60 years ago, when I witnessed a certain lady from the Divine Palace Sect fight against odds far beyond her capabilities,"
The Wicked Poison Witch added a tone that was both nostalgic and impressive.

"Too bad she died early. If she were alive, I know deep in my heart she would be a Sovereign by now." The lady she was talking about was Mara’s big sister, Nara who was now locked in a cage, acting as a battery.
"But this brat is something else. I mean, I wouldn’t be able to remain that calm against Evil Bat," Sword King Shawn said, his voice filled with disbelief.
The other two shared his sentiment, their expressions mirroring his astonishment.
"I guess it’s a good thing I didn’t pursue the issue with my disciple any longer," the Wicked Poison Witch said, clenching her fist.
She still harboured intentions of killing Kent, but watching this battle unfold was beginning to shift her perspective.
"Brilliant swordsman," Sword King Shawn muttered under his breath.
Far from their location, four women were also observing the fight with calm expressions. One was the Auction Master, and another was Alina, who stood beside her.
The Kingdom Protector and her disciple, Yami, were also watching the battle, their expressions shifting between shock and awe.
"So, do you still think you can dominate the Sect Competitions, Yami?" Lady Lani asked with a faint smile.
Yami, who had been confident about dominating the competition, clenched her fist.
"I have to admit, he is indeed capable and brave. But my skills are not to be taken lightly. In a one-on-one duel, I will win," she declared, her voice firm despite the doubt creeping into her mind.
Her master just chuckled.
"Kids, I want you to watch the next 30 seconds closely. If I am not mistaken, the kid is after something, and the next 30 seconds will determine whether the battle will end or not."

All four ladies focused their attention on the battle. Alina was panicking inwardly, but she had to keep reporting to her sisters, who, instead of relaxing inside the tower, were now in a state of panic.
Back on the battlefield...
Kent, who had gotten back up from the ground after being slammed for the umpteenth time, spat out blood.
"Kaizo, do you fear death?" Kent asked.
"That’s the thing, Master. I am already dead," Kaizo replied, flashing a smile at his master. Kent also smiled
"Then why don’t we tempt death? I would like to see how it looks," Kent said, glancing at the watch on his wrist, which had a green circle on it.
"30 seconds."
"The master should indeed die once to know how it feels," Kaizo said, his laughter growing wild as lightning descended from above and bathed him in its radiance.
"Tempest Overdrive!" His voice boomed.
His eyes were now red, and his body was covered in red lightning. The berserk skill in his arsenal had been activated, making him four times stronger and faster.
"Let’s do it, buddy!"
Kaizo moved at a speed that caught the bat off guard. "Eat my fist!" This time, he was so fast that his fist landed on the bat’s chest, sending it flying back.
Kent, who was already in position, moved...
"Chrono Watch: Fast Forward!"
His body moved at a speed that nearly caused him to lose consciousness. He was already at his top speed, so adding 2.5X to it was just too much.
The Chrono watch he received from one of his quests took effect, and the result was him streaking through the air like a comet.
But he controlled the flight as his sword slashed forward. It landed on the evil bat’s face, and a small cut appeared.
"Die, brat!" Kent, who had succeeded in drawing blood, felt the world spin around him as his body smashed into the ground.
The bat moved, but before it could reach Kent’s broken body, a thunderous slap landed on its face.
"Hehe, slapping bats is indeed awesome," Kaizo said. He wasn’t about to let the bat get close to his master who had gotten what he wanted.
The bat became furious...
