chapters.title: Chapter 337: You are fucked for life...bro
paragraphs: From the start of the battle between Kent and the evil bat, his objective wasn’t to kill him. Kent was rather after his blood to end the battle entirely and prove to everyone that he was no pushover.
To achieve this, he needed to unleash a power currently in his possession—a red token.
This token was the Mirror Enemy reward he had earned from the quest.
It was no ordinary item; this token had the potential to shake the entire four kingdoms and awaken the hidden dangers currently lurking in the shadows.
Kaizo was in the air, closing in on the bat, while Kent struggled to his feet and retrieved his sword, now coated with a thin layer of the bat’s blood.
He placed the red token on the blood, and it was instantly absorbed into it.
Kent then cut his palm, allowing his own blood to drip onto the token. The moment the token drank his blood, it flew from his grip and shot toward the sky.
It stopped at the same level as the two combatants, and then—**boom!**—a powerful energy burst forth from it, halting their clash.
Kaizo vanished and reappeared beside his master. He supported him with one arm. The battle dolls surrounded them, their swords firmly gripped and ready.
"What, you think you can stop me with a trinket?" the evil bat sneered.
"Who said anything about stopping you with a trinket? You will be stopping yourself with this trinket," Kent replied, smiling through his blood-soaked teeth.
"Kaizo, do you know what is more annoying and heartbreaking than being cuckolded?" Kent asked.

"I don’t know if anything could be more heartbreaking than seeing your wife get fucked in front of you, but you can enlighten me, Master," Kaizo replied with a smile, not taking his eyes off the bat, who now wore a deep frown.
"Remember these wise words, Kaizo. Treasure them, for a wise man once said: the only thing worse than being cuckolded is fighting a replica of yourself."
Kent clapped his hands together. "Mirror Enemy, activate!"
The red token burst into a swirling red portal that instantly unleashed a powerful energy from within.
Then, through it, a figure emerged, shocking everyone who saw it. The figure was the evil bat—an exact copy of him.
From height to expression, everything mirrored the evil bat, who took a step back in disbelief.

"This is your enemy, Evil Bat. You shouldn’t have come after me for I already told you: if you come after me, do your best to kill me. Failure means this. And let me tell you, I have more where this came from."
Kent’s laughter filled the air.
"This is another you. So unless you have a way of killing yourself without knowing it, then for all eternity, you will keep fighting yourself. Everything you could think of, he already knew"
As if to prove his words, the mirror bat raised its hand, and portals appeared in the air. Red bats flew out from within, attacking the evil bat, who quickly conjured his own bats in defence.
"You can only try to kill yourself before he kills you. And oh, if somebody else manages to kill your clone, you will die.
If they help you kill it, you will die. And lastly, even if you run and hide in the deepest, darkest hole, he will find you.
So, happy fighting—because that’s all you’ll be doing for as long as I will it."
"What my master is trying to say is... you’re fucked for life... bro," Kaizo smirked.
"Brat, do you want to invoke the wrath of the Evil Sect? Do you think we are weak?" the evil bat shouted as blood spears rained down on him.
"Stupid, do you really think I went through all this trouble just to be scared now? You really are stupid.
I killed all these people today because I wanted to, and in the coming months, I will kill more because revenge must be exacted.

So please, send your minions after me, and I will greet them. But even if they don’t come, I will come for them. So welcome me well, because next time, I will ensure your sect is razed to the ground."
Kent swung his sword, and 450 sword arcs rained down on the bat, who cursed under his breath.
"Damn, that feels good," Kent said.
A mirror copy of the bat now occupied the evil bat, so Kent was able to injure him, and the feeling was damn good.
"Let me try it too," Kaizo said, his fist clenched and lightning crackling around it.
"Go for it, buddy. This is our chance to pay him back for all the painful injuries we’ve suffered."

Kaizo shot into the air like a bolt of lightning, his fist slamming into the evil bat’s spine and sending him flying toward the mirror bat, who landed a powerful kick to his chest, sending him hurtling back toward Kent.
Kent closed his eyes, focusing.
When he snapped them open, his aura surged into overdrive. He unleashed a devastating sword slash, creating a massive sword arc that tore through the air.
The attack struck the evil bat’s chest, sending him flying backwards. The bat cursed and fled, attempting to escape.
"Run all you want. In the end, you cannot outrun yourself," Kent said coldly.
The mirror bat began chasing him relentlessly. As Kent said, the mirror copy would forever be his shadow, a relentless pursuer determined to kill him.
In every way, the evil bat was doomed. Until he managed to kill his mirror copy, he would never know peace again.
The thought alone made all those watching break into a cold sweat—exactly as Kent had intended.
"I hope you all saw what I’m capable of, and let me tell you, I have more where that came from. So, if you want, come and get some."
Kent smiled evilly.
"I will be taking the body of the Forest King and everything else I bought from the auction. So, for those of you thinking of robbing me, wipe that idea from your mind."

"If you don’t believe me, come against me any day, and I promise you, I will ensure you don’t leave disappointed." Kent’s bones were broken, but he didn’t let the pain show on his face or in his voice.
"What’s next, Master? I can see some cowards hiding in the bushes. Should we go after them?" Kaizo asked, his tone loud enough to be heard even from hundreds of miles away.
"No need, Kaizo. Cowards are only good at hiding. I’ll let them grow a pair before going after them."
Kent smiled, noticing the fight still burning in the injured undead. The unyielding personality he had added during its creation was in full effect.
"You heard my master. All cowards are free to go... for now. When you grow a pair, you can come for some beatings," Kaizo said before picking Kent up like a prince.
He glanced toward a certain mountain, and in a flash, he was gone, shooting toward it.
The Battle Dolls followed close behind.
Like that, Kent planted the seed of fear in the hearts of all those who witnessed his battle with the evil bat.
Now, they would all think twice before daring to come after him.

chapters.title: Chapter 338: The Pitiful Evil Bat
paragraphs: The battle ended, and everyone left.
Kent was taken away by Kaizo, who had orders from his master to take him away and out of sight before they entered the tower.
So, he flew him many miles away and landed atop a tall mountain. A few seconds later, the battle dolls arrived, and Kent sent them straight to the tower.
He himself appeared inside the Body Tower, where he immediately entered a herbal bath Akira had prepared. He passed out the next second.
Kaizo appeared inside the Legion Tower, where he immediately meditated and began to recover. The battle was beyond their capabilities, yet they had to brave the danger, and it paid off.
Aside from the dozens of Transcendent bodies, they had also defeated a Root Sovereign. The result couldn’t have been any better than this.
A few seconds after Kent passed out, his bloodied body now submerged in the herbal bath, all his ladies except Alina and Vexthra appeared inside the room he was in.
Akira deemed it necessary to bring them, considering Kent wouldn’t be waking up any time soon. Watching the ladies’ panicked expressions, she knew they wouldn’t be at peace until they saw him.
"Master will be unconscious for a while, but don’t worry, he will be fine. He just needs time to recover," Akira said to the teary-eyed ladies now surrounding Kent’s bath.
"Thank you, Akira," Selene said, taking off Kent’s shirt.
"I will be here if you need anything," Akira said before vanishing from the Body Tower and returning to the tower’s core, where Gaia was busy at work.
Kent had his bones broken to such an extent that, had he not stepped into the path of body cultivation, recovery would have been a headache.
Thankfully, he is not a human but a dragon and a body cultivator. This granted him all the qualities needed to recover from such injuries.
So, he was recovering. Meanwhile, on the outside, chaos had erupted.
The Evil Bat, one of the most feared figures on the Human Continent, was now being hunted. Strangely, the one doing the hunting was a replica of himself, linked to his life.
The sudden turn of events took everyone by surprise.

Kent had unleashed a copy of the Evil Bat against him, and from what he said, the only way the Evil Bat could be free was to kill the copy himself. If someone else helped him, he would die along with the copy.
However, nobody had any reason to help him. They all wanted him dead, and the last thing Kent said that piqued their interest was that if someone else killed the copy, the real body would also die.
This was like an open invitation for all those wronged by the Evil Bat to go after the copy.
Dozens went after him. Thankfully, the Evil Sect, who heard word of the sudden turn of events, deployed dozens of Root Transcendents and Ascendants to come to their sect master’s aid.
It ended in a clash between those who wanted the bat dead and those who wanted him alive. A classic royal rumble.
In the end, dozens died from both sides. It reached a point where, instead of protecting just their master, they were forced to protect the copy of their master as well.
If the copy dies, their master would die making all of their efforts end in vain.

Evil Bat, who was severely injured by the copy, was now on his last leg. If he didn’t enter the territory of the Evil Sect, he would die, sparking a frenzy that would sweep across the entire Four Kingdoms.

For five long days, Evil Bat had to use all his trump cards and every ounce of his strength to keep going. Thankfully, he finally made it inside the territory of the Evil Sect, which his pursuers didn’t dare enter.
They knew entering his domain would be like entering the den of a tiger. They are not that desperate yet...at least when their numbers were still limited.
But by the end of the fifth day, thousands from the Evil Sect had died, dealing them a devastating blow and setting them back by many hundreds of years.
However, their worries were far from over.
Kent had promised to eradicate them, and as someone who never breaks his promises, he would do everything in his power to fulfil that vow.
But while the Evil Sect was in panic mode, at the entrance of the Divine Palace Sect, hundreds of people were currently seeking out Kent.
Some were family heads coming to plead for the stupidity of their underlings, thinking they could go against anyone without consequence.
Others came to ask for the space rings around the fingers of some family heads and powerhouses.
Those space rings contained their assets, and they wanted them back. If not, their entire generations will come to an end, unfortunately.
In all, more than a hundred wanted to see him, but Kent was nowhere to be found. In fact, aside from the Master of the Archer Gate telling them to wait for him, nobody else came to talk to them.
Away from the chaos, Alina, who still hadn’t gone inside the tower simply because Lady Lani never let her out of her sight, was now on her way to the sect with her boss.
She had given the Ambrosia Apple to her, and Lady Lani consumed it before her. For seven days, she was in a meditative state.
When she finally woke up, her spirit roots, which had been at the Platinum stage, had advanced to the Dark Gold stage. This filled her with so much happiness.
Immediately, she wanted to meet Kent.
Alina, who knew Kent wasn’t at the sect, tried to convince Lady Lani to wait until the Pill Master Competition, which was 19 days away.
However, the lady was too enthusiastic to meet her benefactor and insisted they go. So, they were now headed to the sect, where they would wait for him to return, even if it took a month.
Alina, of course, saw where this was going, but she was more than happy to let it play out. She could only follow Lady Lani and act like her sister, knowing they would soon be sister wives.
Meanwhile, 15 days after the battle, things for the Evil Sect still hadn’t stabilized.
They kept getting attacked every now and then, keeping them on high alert. Their sect master, who had managed to escape the clone, was now in seclusion.
But the clone was nearby, ready to attack the moment he came out. It wouldn’t go after others unless they attacked it first.
Of course, the sect members wouldn’t do that, as they were waiting for their sect master to level up so he could finally gain the upper hand.
They also cannot attack the Clone simply because they cannot, and second, they wouldn’t dare, considering doing so would be aiding their master, who would die when the clone dies.
Then again, if only they knew that the moment Evil Bat reached the second level, the clone would also advance; perhaps they would have given up and run for their lives.
The day the sect master died would be the day they all knew despair.

chapters.title: Chapter 339: Planning a Welcome Party for Their Man
paragraphs: It has been 15 days since the battle, but to the ladies inside the Celestial-grade tower, it has been 360 days. The time difference between the tower and the outside was just too vast.
They had been inside the tower for close to a year, and within those 360 days, a lot had happened.
When they appeared inside the tower where Kent’s wounded body was lying unconscious in the herbal bath, they all broke into tears.
The sight before them was too heartbreaking. They couldn’t handle it, so they became emotional. Even Mara, Camilla, and Val weren’t spared.
However, after the emotional interlude, they began caring for him as the days went by. They made sure he wasn’t alone, staying by his side for weeks without leaving.

But three months into the waiting, the ladies—who had finally managed to stop blaming themselves for being weak—came up with a plan. This plan required them to ensure their men woke up stronger and healthier.
So, they started training.
All of them inside the tower began training. They also started tempering their bodies, thanks to Akira providing them with everything they needed.
They also started using the Stairway to strengthen their bodies further, ensuring that the next time Kent saw them, they would be at a level where he would allow them to fight alongside him.
So, for months, they kept training. By the time 10 months were over, Elsa managed to reach the peak of the Root Sage stage after levelling up three times.
This made her stronger and added thousands of stat points to Kent’s reserves, which had been depleted to zero after using everything during the battles.
Unity and Lilain also broke through to the Root Sage stage, even rising to level 3.
Selene and Ingrid climbed to level 5 Root Great Sages, becoming monsters in their own right. This further contributed to Kent’s strength.
However, Neomi, who is the most talented among them all, rose to the peak of the Root Great Sage stage, ready to become a Root Transcendent.
Even Mara and Camilla reached the peak of the Root Transcendent stage and began preparing to become Root Ascension stage experts.
As for Val, she had entered the 4th stage of the Root Great Sage stage. Of course, she chose to spend most of her time with Kent instead of training.
While her sisters were away, she kept Kent company.
They tried very hard, and it paid off.
Alina was stuck with her boss so she was the only one who didn’t get to join this training.
"Are you ladies sure Kent will be impressed when he wakes up?" Neomi asked. "You clearly heard what Alina said—Kent not only killed Transcendents, he even defeated a Sovereign."
"Relax, Kent isn’t one to care about stuff like this. He will be impressed regardless of whether or not we became who we are," Selene said, taking her sister’s hand.
"I just want him to be able to count on us next time."
They all meant that. They wanted to fight beside him.
"Let’s just wait for him till he wakes up. I know he will be happy to see us again," Unity said, already planning to hug him for ten whole minutes before letting go.
"Yeah, let’s wait for him to wake up. We’ve each leveled up multiple times, which means his strength has risen again. I’m sure that will be enough to get him on his feet."
The ladies nodded.

They had already revealed to the three ladies yet to join the harem about the influence they had on their man. They told them that aside from having sex with him, he also grew stronger just from their cultivation.
This made them want to join the harem so they could also contribute, but Selene told them to relax until Kent woke up.
"I offered to give him my body so he could grow stronger much faster, but he rejected me," Mara said, looking at the sleeping body in the bath.

"Yeah... Kent said we are his women, not batteries. So, though having sex with you would make him happy, he wouldn’t do it if the reason behind it was just to help him grow stronger," Selene explained.
"I just wanted to help," Mara said with a sigh.
"You being here is enough. Plus, he didn’t reject you entirely, so just wait for him to wake up. I’m sure he will take the next step with you all then," Selene said, comforting her.
"But even if he doesn’t, you can still squeeze his balls dry using your mouth." The ladies blushed at such a comment.
"We should probably make sure he doesn’t go anywhere for the next few weeks. I don’t know about you ladies, but I’m going seven rounds with him," Selene said.
"Same here. Until I pass out for the seventh time, I won’t let him go," Elsa seconded her words. They all wanted to make sure their man woke up to a moment he would never forget.
The battle had been harrowing.
They couldn’t help then, but that didn’t mean they wouldn’t be able to help now. They had already added thousands of points for him to use later.
Now, they were planning on how best to help him recover fully from the battle. So, as his ladies, they all wanted to use their bodies to achieve that.
Kent would probably be smiling if he were in a position to hear their cheeky comments.
"I second what Mom said, too, let’s suck him dry," Lilian said with a smile. The ladies looked at the mother and daughter weirdly.
"Then why don’t we make it a group thing? We should each help one another to make sure he passes out again—and this time, not from getting beaten up," Unity joked.
"You’ll be in trouble if he hears you saying he was beaten up," Lilian teased.
"Well, he’s passed out, so there’s no way he can hear that. But even if he did, he *was* indeed beaten up. He’ll just have to put on his big boy pants and man up," Unity giggled.
But then she froze when a voice entered her ears.
"Why don’t I show you how I was beaten up..." Kent spoke, grabbing her waist.

chapters.title: Chapter 340: Catching up
paragraphs: "Kent..."
The ladies shouted when they heard his voice again after an entire year of him being in a comatose state.
They all became emotional, tears streaming down their eyes.
"Sorry for making you ladies worry about me. I never expected the fight to end that way," Kent said with a smile, trying to stand up.
Unity, who was now literally in the bath with him, helped him up. They all surrounded him, none of them able to maintain a calm expression.
Each of them was in tears, making Kent curse the bat for that body slam at the end of their battle. That was what had rattled him and broken almost all the bones in his body.
When he gets the chance again, he will make sure the bat feels the pain he was in times 100. In fact, he will ensure he feels the pain deep within his bones.
"I’m fine, ladies. I just needed a few hours to get back on my feet," Kent said, trying to comfort them. "My body is healed now, and my bones are back to normal. I really am fine."
The ladies continued to shed tears for a couple of minutes until they managed to calm down. But when they did, they each came in for a kiss, showing how much they had missed him.
"I missed you, Kent," Unity said.
"I know you do. If you didn’t, you wouldn’t have started plotting to make me pass out again," Kent said as he grabbed her butt and squeezed it.
"But then again, passing out from getting beaten up in bed by you ladies wouldn’t be too bad."
They all blushed. Hearing his shameless remark was enough to tell them he was back and well.
"Kent, we know you are in no shape now to spend time with all of us, so why don’t we let you recover fully first," Selene said, looking at her sisters.
They could tell Kent wanted to ensure they were okay, but he was also still too weak to do anything.
"Also, while we would like to hear all about your battle with the Evil sect, what we want to know however is why you didn’t tell us anything about the sect master." Selene asked with a frown.
Kent smiled and looked at Mara, who was hiding her face behind Camilla. She may have blurted out some fine details to the ladies.
"Don’t blame her, Kent. She was so heartbroken when she saw your body here that she told us everything."
"Who said I blame her? I just didn’t know things would have ended the way they did. But it’s good to see you all again, and you all have grown stronger.

However, don’t think I will be asking you all to jump into danger just because I got my ass handed to me. I will reveal everything, and if possible, I will ask you ladies to help me save her sister and her disciple."
Kent sighed, remembering the battle that could have ended differently had he failed to draw Evil Bat’s blood when he did.
"During the battle, I couldn’t help but wonder what you all would be going through. Now that I am back, and thanks to you all, my strength has increased, I will reveal all the plans soon.
But first, where is Alina?"
The ladies smiled, hearing all he said.
In fact, they were relieved he mentioned he would need them. Had he been stubborn and chosen to fly solo, they would have probably tied him down and beaten some sense into him.
"Alina is with her boss. She seems to have taken a liking to her and never lets her out of her sight. But if you want to see her, then hurry up and go back to the sect.
However, that can wait for now, because the next 24 days will be spent with us all. She can wait one more day."
Selene had probably taken on the role of their big sister and shameless spokesperson, so whatever they all wanted to say, she found a way to make it sound normal.
Alina had already used her smart to trap them, now, they will also spend this moment without her.
"Good for her, I guess. But when she gets her turn, you ladies won’t be welcome."
"That will depend on how good you make us feel in the next 24 days," Elsa smiled lustfully.
"Then I will be sure to make you all pass out at least seven times," Kent smiled, showing them he was awake the entire time and had heard their plans.
"But first, why don’t I tell you all about the events that will be happening from the moment we go back out there?"
The ladies focused their attention on this, as it was something they all wanted to hear.
"Since Mara has already told you about her sister and Camilla about her disciple, I will now tell you all about the plan.
Currently, I have a way to create powerful figures who will fight for me. I know Alina has already told you about the big guy who was the sole reason I am still alive.
I also know you all are wondering where he came from.
The answer to that is, I created him."
"Wait, say that again," Selene interrupted. "Are you saying you created a Peak Root Transcendent?"
"Yes. I can create undead figures. The big guy Alina told you about was a result of the skull I bought from the auction and the dead bodies of those who attacked us.
And as you all know, I bought quite a few items. Now, since I have hundreds of dead bodies, I will ensure the mission won’t become as dangerous as the one that ended with the evil sect."

"Unbelievable. I’ve never heard of anyone having such an ability—to create someone who can take on a Sovereign and even kill Ascension-stage experts like it was nothing. This is just too much for any of us"
The ladies were in disbelief.
"No need to overthink it. I’ve already made plans to unleash your potential soon, so who knows what you all will be capable of when that happens?"
"But this is just unbelievable. Not only are you a dragon—" Selene, who was too happy for her man, blurted out his secret mistakenly but stopped herself from revealing too much.
However, she had already revealed enough for the ladies to hear what she said, and they were now looking at Kent with expressions that said, *Please, we want to see your dragon horns.*
"Sorry," Selene said, covering her face though she was smiling.
"No need to look shocked, ladies. I am indeed a dragon, but not fully a dragon yet. In a way, you can just call me a demi-dragon, for I can’t transform into a dragon yet."
"Then did you come from the Dragon Continent?" Elsa asked.
"Nope, but I plan on going there soon."
"Then where did you come from? I doubt there are dragons on this continent," Lilian followed up with her question.
"For that, you all can ask Vexthra," Kent smiled, already feeling energized. He could tell from how he felt that revealing some of his secrets had made him much more relaxed.
Two hours later, he was full of energy, so they vanished into the Harem Tower and appeared on the large bed.
Unity quickly went for the dragon rod.

I can already see him falling for my sucking skills," Elsa smiled.
"Our sucking skills, Mom.
Don’t make it singular," Lilian said with a grin.
"Sorry, Lil.
Our sucking skills," Elsa corrected.
The ladies smirked at their antics and entered the pool.
Unity, who had the smallest and least developed body, sighed and followed them.
’I have something they don’t have, and that is my...’
She smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 346: Upgrading The Metal Doll
paragraphs: "Master, you are finally here," Kaizo said, walking toward Kent, who appeared inside the Legion Tower.
"Yeah, that bat got me good in the last moments of the battle, so I had to sleep for a year." Kent smiled, remembering how the world spun around him when he landed on the ground.
"He got us good, Master, but I plan on getting back at him," Kaizo said, his unyielding personality oozing as he spoke.
"We will, buddy. The bat will regret coming against us."
If possible, Kaizo would want to go after the bat now. However, Kent already has things to do first, so the bat, who is fucked for life, can wait.
If the clone doesn’t kill him, Kent will do it himself.
"How is your training coming along?" Kent asked.
"I have mastered all my skills and can now use them more actively without causing too much damage to my allies."
Kaizo is a brute fighter, so naturally, the damage he causes is more than enough to disturb his allies.
But he spent the past year training on how best to minimize how he affects his allies and how best to increase his offensive power.
"I see. But don’t worry too much. The next opponent we’ll be going after is already as good as dead." Kent and Kaizo smiled. They would be lying if they said the battle with the bat wasn’t fun.
They had fun, and now, they want more.
"But how does this work? Do you, like, have memories of your past, or are you having some memories that show who you were? Or are you a blank slate?"
Kent created him, but he could tell by the way Kaizo behaved during the battle that he was someone with a lot of battle experience.
This means he might have been a warrior from somewhere.

"That’s the thing, Master. I am a blank slate; however, I don’t feel like that. It feels more like I have always been me. It doesn’t feel like I have just been born," Kaizo explained, making Kent ponder something.
"Strange," Kent brushed his temple. "Your bloodline says you are from the Mountain Thunder Titan race. However, you don’t remember ever being part of such a life."
"I am a new me, Master, and that is good enough for me," Kaizo smiled.
"I guess that’s okay." Kent planned on getting deeper into this, mainly because he wanted to know more about his undead.
Kaizo is the first, and soon, he will be adding six more, all of whom are predicted to be at the Root Ascension stage. So, he wanted to know more about his first undead.
This will help him understand more about their nature and how best to create the new undead he plans to make right after he reviews what needs to be reviewed.
"Akira," Kent called out to the loli, who had been managing everything while Gaia worked on the projects she had been given.
⟪Good to see you are well, Master. For a moment there, I thought you had kicked the bucket.⟫
"Would you have cried?" Kent asked with a smirk.
⟪Probably not. I would have waited for you to reincarnate.⟫ Akira giggled, but lowkey, she was very happy with her master as well.
"How is Gaia doing?"
⟪Madam Perfection is placing some finishing touches on the projects. She will be done in a week’s time.⟫
"That is good. I will just wait out the seven days on the outside, considering it will be seven hours there." Kent smiled, making Kaizo, who was told the same thing by the small human, smile as well.
"I need friends I can spar with. The Metal Dolls are too weak," Kaizo said, clenching his fist. Kent turned and looked at him with a smirk.
"You should find a hobby. A wise man once said, ’All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy.’"
"Then why don’t I go after those hateful bats? I say we destroy them to the last bat." Kaizo beat his chest, showing that he was ready for more fights.
The brute in him is just too much...
"We have battles to fight, and one of them is against an evil cultivator who must die screaming," Kent said with an evil smile.
"I will prepare then," Kaizo said, returning to resume training.
⟪I have divided the items into seven segments. Each is enough to create a powerful undead. I have also created one undead using the schematic builder and modified the two schematics.
You can make changes to it later, but I believe you will like them.⟫
"That is great, Akira. I will reward you later, but right now, I want to upgrade the Battle Doll. I am sure with the Meteor, it will become much more powerful."
⟪The master shouldn’t worry about that. The earlier you do it, the faster you will gain another Transcendent on the team.
You have less than 15 days to go before the rescue quest runs out, and you will lose the benefits that were added.⟫
"Then let’s do it." Kent summoned the doll and retrieved the meteor.
"Damn, it’s heavy." The dark stone weighed heavier than it looked.
"What next?"
Akira gestured downward, and a spell circle appeared on the ground. The doll was standing inside the circle, and from the way it appeared, the circle was already affecting the stone.
⟪Place the stone inside the circle. Next time, you can just think it, and it will come.⟫
Kent added the stone and moved back. Immediately after he did, a message appeared.
⟪Upgrade in Progress⟫
→ Your Battle Doll is currently undergoing an upgrade. This process will take 2 days to complete.
→ No new items can be added during the process.
→ The moment it’s done, you will receive a notification.
"Please tell me it’s tower time," Kent said, looking at Akira, who was already smiling.
⟪Don’t worry, master. Aside from the Creator Necromancer class, everything else runs on tower time.⟫
"That’s good then." Kent also smiled. "Why don’t we go commission a new undead? Since it uses the outside world time, I need to start early so I can be prepared by the time I get back to the sect."
⟪Okay, master, but we can only do one at a time.⟫
"No problem with that. Kaizo and I will raid one dungeon before the mission, so I’ll have a dungeon boss on speed dial too."
⟪You are a learning master. Proud of you,⟫ Akira giggled, but before she knew it, Kent had picked her up like a bag of potatoes.

chapters.title: Chapter 347: Creating the Second Undead, Battle Doll Upgraded
paragraphs: ⟪Master, put me down.⟫ Akira giggled as they stepped into the necro forge.
"You’ve grown cheeky," Kent smiled. "Sometimes, I can’t help but wonder if you’re an anime character."
⟪What? Who said I’m an anime character? I am not an anime character!⟫ Akira’s giggle disappeared, and a slight panic could be seen on her face.
"Whatever you say. I just hope that is the case... I really hope for that," Kent smiled and chuckled, making Akira curse the bastard in her heart.
"Show me the undead you’ve created." Akira quickly took out the Undead Schematic Creator. She activated it, and a hologram of a figure appeared.
"This is..." Kent raised an eyebrow.
⟪Don’t look shocked, Master. I put my entire soul into this, and let me tell you, as a soul weaver, my soul is rather large.
Also, a part of the domain crystal, the darkness crystal, the eyes of the forest king, one arm, 5 Transcendent bodies, 25 Great Sage bodies, and 1 trillion spirit stones.
For the ascension bodies, you can use them later.
Those are the materials required for this undead. Please thank me afterwards.⟫
Kent smiled.
"I won’t make many changes, Akira. I trust you, so let’s do it." She smiled and activated the forge. She placed the schematic on it and continued with the rest of the process.
After everything was added, the timer was set for 48 hours, making it 2 days.
"Let’s go back and eat something." They left the tower and went to the tower shop to buy some chocolates from Earth.
"Cosmic weavers are the best," Kent smiled as he bit into a chocolate.
⟪I know, right? Gaia is just a cheat. She can take anything from anywhere and even create anything using cosmic energy. Sometimes I am jealous of her.⟫
"No need to be jealous of her. You are special in your own way," Kent said, making Akira smile.
⟪But Mind Weaver is the best. She is literally the ultimate cheat. If she were to be around, the rescue mission would be as easy as walking in there and walking out.⟫
"We will rescue her in the coming days."
⟪Thank you, Master.⟫
"You can just call me Kent when we are alone," Kent said, but the soul weaver shook her head.
⟪Master is Master, so he can only be called Master.⟫
"Suit yourself. But don’t worry too much about your sister. She will be rescued soon."
They stayed in the tower shop for hours until the tower message appeared.
"The upgrade is finished." Akira and Kent vanished and appeared inside the Legion Tower, where the Battle Doll had now taken on a new look.
"Damn, that is one terrifying knight right there," Kent’s smile bloomed as he looked at the dark and red metal knight holding a large sword.
It wore a helmet with sharp spikes and glowing red slits for eyes, making it appear inhuman.
The armour was sleek but covered in jagged, blade-like edges, giving it an aggressive and warlike look and aura.
Red energy pulsed through the veins of its armour. Its gauntlets were reinforced, with claw-like fingertips that could tear through steel. Nobody would enjoy getting punched by that.
A long, flowing black cape trailed behind it. Kent didn’t know where that came from, but he was pleased.
The ancient writings on the armour even suggested it was something taken from legends and myths.
Perhaps it was one of the unholy knights that guarded the dark city of Sabatan.
But while it looked imposing, the greatsword in its hands was enough to strike fear into anyone’s heart.
It was a massive black greatsword etched with glowing red runes. The sword appeared to be infused with a dark force as crimson energy seeped from its edges.
[Image of veydris]
⟪Congratulations, Master. That is one terrifying figure capable of using Void energy. You should be proud.⟫
"I am proud, Akira. This is one terrifying knight," Kent said, his smile contagious. "Akira, did I ever tell you how much I am fascinated by knights?"
⟪You never told me, but I can already see it on your face. You are like a child who has received his Christmas gift from his long-lost ex-girlfriend,⟫ Akira giggled.
"At least I am not an anime character," Kent fired back, making Akira glare at him.
⟪Brand it with your soul energy to connect it to your soul. Though it doesn’t have a soul, it has the ability to reap souls, which will benefit your soul cultivation.⟫
Kent nodded and placed the soul brand on the Metal Doll, which went to its knee and gave him a knight’s salute right after the branding.
"Oh my, this is the best," Kent said, almost giggling. He took out his sword and, like a lord, placed it on the shoulder of the Metal Doll.
"Rise, Sir Veydris. Your legend has just begun," Kent declared, but the next second, his eyes widened when a message appeared right after naming the Metal Knight.
⟪Congratulations on naming your first Knight. You have received the title Master of the Lost Knights.⟫
[Master of the Lost Knights]
→ During the last war of Sanguine, the 14 guardian Knights of Sabatan fought as the first and last stand against the Creatures of the Night.
→ It was said that during the final phase of the siege, the 14 knights laid down their lives to protect the lost children of the mother.
→ Because of their sacrifice, when the mother received her children, she named them the Guardians of the Lost, for she knew once they were lost, they would be found again.
→ You now have the ability to find and awaken these brave knights, for they must exact their revenge when the end comes knocking.
→ Whenever a Lost Knight is nearby, you will know and awaken them, for that is your duty as the Master of the Lost Knights.
Kent remained frozen as he read and reread the messages in front of him. It just didn’t make sense, as this was something he never expected.
All he wanted was to give a cool name of one of his favorite game characters to the metal knight, but instead, he ended up awakening a lost knight.
⟪Master is very lucky. The Lost Knights of Sabatan, huh? It’s been a long time since I heard of the bravest knights to have ever lived.⟫

chapters.title: Chapter 348: Veydris, the Abyss Knight
paragraphs: "Akira, you wouldn’t happen to know a thing or two about the Lost Knights, would you?" Kent asked, looking at the small human standing beside him.
His interest has been piqued after Akira made that comment.
⟪That’s the thing, Master. In the billions of years this universe has existed, many events have happened that, for some reason, are wiped from everyone’s mind.
A typical example is the Night Riders. Their times were pivotal moments, yet they were lost in history. This history of the Lost Knights and the Last War of the Sanguine has also been lost to time.
However, now that I have seen these names and descriptions, I can start recalling some of these events.
And from what I know about the War of the Sanguine and the Lost Knights, I have to say, Master, you are very fortunate.⟫
"Do tell, Akira," Kent smiled, glancing at Veydris, who stood with his greatsword jammed into the ground like the knight he is.
⟪I can’t accurately say much about the War of the Sanguine, but I can say something about the Lost Knights and the events that led to their demise.
I know that the Lost Knights were known as the Knights of the Mother. Many also called them the guardians of the abominations.
The reason is simple: these 14 knights protected the Temple of Sabatan. Before we talk about how they died, know that the Temple of Sabatan was the gateway to the Realm of the Lost.
Again, before we discuss the Realm of the Lost, we must first understand who the Lost are. In the vast cosmos, some races prohibit interracial marriages.
Among these races are the ancient Vampires and the true Werewolves.
Long ago, and even to this day, if two beings of opposite sexes from different races come together and copulate, their children are deemed abominations.
As such, they are either killed or banished. Because of this, most parents hide their children to avoid discovery. But if they are discovered, they sometimes send them away to safe havens.
One of these havens is the Realm of the Lost.
It was said that when an abomination reaches the Temple of Sabatan, its name changes to "Lost Child." The temple wardens take in all these children.
It was also said that even if an emperor was chasing after them, the moment they entered the temple, the 14 knights would not allow anyone to harm them.
They were that monstrous.
This temple is the gateway to the Realm of the Lost, a secret realm said to have originated in the primordial era and is protected by the Mother.
She welcomes her children and ensures they are shielded from harm.
However, over time, the Lost Children began to grow into powerhouses, and as a result, the various races opposed to these abominations grew uneasy.
So, the ancient Vampires, known as the Creatures of the Night, launched an attack, and the sympathizers of the abominations retaliated.
The war, which initially had no name, quickly became known as the Sanguine War. It was said that the more death and destruction there was, the stronger the Creatures of the Night became.
Blood was their weapon, and as more died, they grew unstoppable.

It was said that when they reached the Temple of Sabatan, they were like supreme warriors bathed in blood. However, the last stand against them was the 14 guardians, whose origins and nature remained a mystery.
It was said that each guardian slew 6,666 Creatures of the Night, but there were simply too many. In a final, desperate effort, they used their life essence to seal the Realm of the Lost.⟫
Akira and Kent looked at the metal knight, and smiles appeared on their faces.
⟪Veydris, the Abyss Knight. He was the Void Guardian, one who could kill someone from thousands of miles away with a single slash of his greatsword.
He was said to have supreme control over the void and could wield it with his sword as effortlessly as one drinks water.
I don’t know much about the others, but now that I know his name is Veydris, I can tell you he was a formidable harbinger of souls, a demonic swordsman, the Void Cutter...⟫
As Akira listed his titles, Kent noticed the red slits of Veydris’s eyes begin to glow, and his grip on his sword tightened.
⟪I only have one piece of advice for you, Master. Make sure to keep upgrading him and, if possible, awaken the others.
I believe the battle dolls are destined to become these knights. This means you still have nine battle dolls to acquire, and each will require upgrades.
So, you’ll need to start seeking out quests instead of waiting for them to come to you.⟫
"I’ll do that, Akira," Kent said, his gaze fixed on the knight before him.
"Kaizo, you have a partner to train with," Kent announced, prompting Kaizo, who was punching a dummy, to grin. Kent smirked and then issued a command to the knight.
"Don’t kill him too many times. I don’t want him traumatized."
Veydris turned to face the brute, then vanished and reappeared inside an arena Akira had built for Kaizo to train in.
⟪He’s going to traumatize him,⟫ Akira remarked.
"I know. But I’ll just cheer him up when we go back out there. We’ll do some dungeon runs to bring back his lost spirit," Kent smiled.
⟪It’s all coming together, Master. Very soon, you will understand the importance of this tower and how best to utilize it. Just keep going. Gaia and I are always available to help.⟫
"It warms my heart to hear that, Akira. I’ll be sure to ask for her help when and if I need it."
⟪One last thing. Saden and her teammates arrived a month ago. It seems they’ve killed everyone linked to the slave business the Malric were running.
They even went as far as hunting down those who bought slaves from them and eliminating everyone.
So, aside from your battle with the evil sect and those idiots, the sudden massacre of hundreds by some mysterious figures has also become a topic of discussion in the town.⟫
Akira smiled.
⟪I have to admit, the Night Rider lady is very thorough with her killing, and those Soul Sentinels are equally monstrous.⟫

sentences.text: "Akira, you wouldn’t happen to know a thing or two about the Lost Knights, would you?" Kent asked, looking at the small human standing beside him.
His interest has been piqued after Akira made that comment.
⟪That’s the thing, Master.
In the billions of years this universe has existed, many events have happened that, for some reason, are wiped from everyone’s mind.
A typical example is the Night Riders.
Their times were pivotal moments, yet they were lost in history.
This history of the Lost Knights and the Last War of the Sanguine has also been lost to time.
However, now that I have seen these names and descriptions, I can start recalling some of these events.
And from what I know about the War of the Sanguine and the Lost Knights, I have to say, Master, you are very fortunate.⟫
"Do tell, Akira," Kent smiled, glancing at Veydris, who stood with his greatsword jammed into the ground like the knight he is.
⟪I can’t accurately say much about the War of the Sanguine, but I can say something about the Lost Knights and the events that led to their demise.
I know that the Lost Knights were known as the Knights of the Mother.
Many also called them the guardians of the abominations.
The reason is simple: these 14 knights protected the Temple of Sabatan.
Before we talk about how they died, know that the Temple of Sabatan was the gateway to the Realm of the Lost.
Again, before we discuss the Realm of the Lost, we must first understand who the Lost are.
In the vast cosmos, some races prohibit interracial marriages.
Among these races are the ancient Vampires and the true Werewolves.
Long ago, and even to this day, if two beings of opposite sexes from different races come together and copulate, their children are deemed abominations.
As such, they are either killed or banished.
Because of this, most parents hide their children to avoid discovery.
But if they are discovered, they sometimes send them away to safe havens.
One of these havens is the Realm of the Lost.
It was said that when an abomination reaches the Temple of Sabatan, its name changes to "Lost Child." The temple wardens take in all these children.
It was also said that even if an emperor was chasing after them, the moment they entered the temple, the 14 knights would not allow anyone to harm them.
They were that monstrous.
This temple is the gateway to the Realm of the Lost, a secret realm said to have originated in the primordial era and is protected by the Mother.
She welcomes her children and ensures they are shielded from harm.
However, over time, the Lost Children began to grow into powerhouses, and as a result, the various races opposed to these abominations grew uneasy.
So, the ancient Vampires, known as the Creatures of the Night, launched an attack, and the sympathizers of the abominations retaliated.
The war, which initially had no name, quickly became known as the Sanguine War.
It was said that the more death and destruction there was, the stronger the Creatures of the Night became.
Blood was their weapon, and as more died, they grew unstoppable.
It was said that when they reached the Temple of Sabatan, they were like supreme warriors bathed in blood.
However, the last stand against them was the 14 guardians, whose origins and nature remained a mystery.
It was said that each guardian slew 6,666 Creatures of the Night, but there were simply too many.
In a final, desperate effort, they used their life essence to seal the Realm of the Lost.⟫
Akira and Kent looked at the metal knight, and smiles appeared on their faces.
⟪Veydris, the Abyss Knight.
He was the Void Guardian, one who could kill someone from thousands of miles away with a single slash of his greatsword.
He was said to have supreme control over the void and could wield it with his sword as effortlessly as one drinks water.
I don’t know much about the others, but now that I know his name is Veydris, I can tell you he was a formidable harbinger of souls, a demonic swordsman, the Void Cutter...⟫
As Akira listed his titles, Kent noticed the red slits of Veydris’s eyes begin to glow, and his grip on his sword tightened.
⟪I only have one piece of advice for you, Master.
Make sure to keep upgrading him and, if possible, awaken the others.
I believe the battle dolls are destined to become these knights.
This means you still have nine battle dolls to acquire, and each will require upgrades.
So, you’ll need to start seeking out quests instead of waiting for them to come to you.⟫
"I’ll do that, Akira," Kent said, his gaze fixed on the knight before him.
"Kaizo, you have a partner to train with," Kent announced, prompting Kaizo, who was punching a dummy, to grin.
Kent smirked and then issued a command to the knight.
"Don’t kill him too many times.
I don’t want him traumatized."
Veydris turned to face the brute, then vanished and reappeared inside an arena Akira had built for Kaizo to train in.
⟪He’s going to traumatize him,⟫ Akira remarked.
"I know.
But I’ll just cheer him up when we go back out there.
We’ll do some dungeon runs to bring back his lost spirit," Kent smiled.
⟪It’s all coming together, Master.
Very soon, you will understand the importance of this tower and how best to utilize it.
Just keep going.
Gaia and I are always available to help.⟫
"It warms my heart to hear that, Akira.
I’ll be sure to ask for her help when and if I need it."
⟪One last thing.
Saden and her teammates arrived a month ago.
It seems they’ve killed everyone linked to the slave business the Malric were running.
They even went as far as hunting down those who bought slaves from them and eliminating everyone.
So, aside from your battle with the evil sect and those idiots, the sudden massacre of hundreds by some mysterious figures has also become a topic of discussion in the town.⟫
Akira smiled.
⟪I have to admit, the Night Rider lady is very thorough with her killing, and those Soul Sentinels are equally monstrous.⟫

chapters.title: Chapter 349: Stats, Rewards, & More
paragraphs: ⟪Name: Veydris, the Abyss Knight⟫
⟪Job Class: Abyss Knight (Void Guardian)⟫
⟪Class Rank: SSS⟫
⟪Grade: Root Transcendent (Peak)⟫
⟪Void Energy Affinity: 28% (High)⟫
⟪Abyssal Energy Affinity: 32% (High)⟫
The details of the metal knight were extraordinary.
Not only is he a peak transcendent, but his class is also SSS-ranked. He possesses two types of energy sources, each among the most lethal in the known universe.
The void and the abyss are forces to be feared; combined, they are even more formidable.
"Too bad I don’t have more Void Stones. Otherwise, he could have grown to a stage where his void and abyss energy affinities would be in the 40s."
Kent looked at the data for a few minutes and then chose to focus on the job class.
⟪Job Class: Abyss Knight (Void Guardian)⟫
→ Veydris is a warrior infused with the power of the Abyss and the Void.
→ His fighting style combines strength, dark magic, and precise swordsmanship.
→ He moves with unnatural speed for someone wearing such heavy armour.
→ His presence instils fear in weaker opponents as if they are staring into an endless abyss.
"This is just too good. At least with something like this, making the hearts of my enemies tremble even before the battle won’t be too difficult."
⟪The Master really needs to grow his own strength so you don’t look like a chicken among your subordinates.⟫
Akira giggled, teasing her master.
"You just had to tease me, huh? If I were to use the Universe Token to wish for knowledge of everything about your life, from the Big Bang to now, I’m sure a lot of juicy stuff would be uncovered."
Akira froze, her smile fading as she heard such a threat from her master.
⟪The Master shouldn’t worry about stuff like this. Using such a valuable item to find dirt on me makes you appear petty.⟫
"But I am petty. I am the prettiest man you will ever meet. So I guess using the token that way will be a good investment."
⟪But you’re planning on using it to save Dori, don’t waste it on something so trivial ⟫ The loli looked desperate despite knowing Kent was just messing with her.
Akiriana, the most famous anime character to have ever blessed the anime world, was now looking never to let her master uncover her embarrassing past.
"Let’s continue. Veydris also has a personality. I would like to see what makes him unique." Kent smiled and pulled up the messages for the personality.
[Personality]
→ Cold and Calculating: Veydris never acts without purpose. He is always thinking ahead, analyzing his enemies’ weaknesses.
→ Unyielding: Nothing can sway him once he has chosen a path. His will is ironclad, and he does not fear death.
→ Loyal to the Abyss: He serves an unknown entity from the Void, possibly a forgotten god or an ancient force.
→ Vengeful: If someone crosses him, he will pursue them until they are erased from existence.
"These are just too cool and very similar to the Veydris I heard of. They said during the battle, all the knights fought to the bitter end.
They never yielded, even when the odds were stacked against them. So these personalities perfectly describe him. I can already see him fighting for weeks nonstop."
Kent smiled and looked toward the Brute and the Night, who were locked in a staring contest. Kaizo had blood at the corner of his mouth.
This only means the sparring session wasn’t going too well for him.
"He also has dozens of skills. I guess the skills I gave him have been turned into powerful ones."

Kent spent some time reading through all his skills, and by the time he was done, he became convinced that he would need to put in a lot of work if he wanted to rise to the level of this metal knight.
"This is good. I am even ready for the rescue mission, but let me check the rewards from the quest."
He pulled up the window, and for a moment, he nearly bit his tongue.
⟪You have successfully proven to the four kingdoms that you are no pushover, and in doing so, you have completed a mega quest. Your rewards have been released.⟫
[Rewards: Received]
→ Tower City (Your Dream City)
→ 15th Primordial Sword Path
→ 11th Primordial Spear Path
→ Memory Key (Jest)
→ Undead Schematic Creator x2
→ Undead Schematic x2
→ Dungeon Seeker Card Upgrader
→ Dungeon Master Token
→ S-Ranked Dungeon Seeker Card (One Dungeon)
"Wow, that is a lot, right?"
Akira nodded, reading the messages. The rewards are indeed out of this world.
Kent took out the Undead Schematic Creator and the Undead Schematic cards.
"Here you go. Design the remaining undead to your liking. When Dori is rescued, she will help you, but since she is not here yet, use this chance to show her what you can do."
"Are you sure?" Akira looked touched. This was a huge deal, and Kent tossed it to her like it was no big deal.
The undead are beings that will follow her master for years to come, so creating the best ones is a must. Yet, he wanted her to do it.
"You are important to me, Akira, and since you want to be useful, use these tokens to become useful. Whatever you come up with, I will be happy regardless, so get creative."
Kent smiled at Loli, who was about to cry. Perhaps this was a big deal to her, considering she didn’t know how Kent would react when she was designing the others without his permission.
So this was really big for her.
"Thank you for trusting me, Master. I will not fail you." A smile appeared on her small face.
"You will never fail me, Akira, because if you did, I would be forced to make a wish, and you wouldn’t like that wish... Hahaha."
"You."
"Looks like the universe has already made provisions for the two ladies we will be rescuing soon. This is good, I guess."
Two new primordial paths have been added to the rewards, each for the two ladies.
"The master is allowed to be happy, and if the ladies make you happy, then the universe would ensure they don’t pull you down."
"Give these two to Gaia and tell her to rest for a few days before starting them." Akira took the manuals and vanished with a smile on her face.
But a second later, a clone of her appeared smiling at Kent.
"If you can hear me, Universe, thank you. And don’t worry, if anyone dares threaten you, I will give them a good beating," Kent joked as he looked at the rest of the rewards.
Unbeknownst to him, the universe smiled at his cheeky comment.

chapters.title: Chapter 350: The Universe Is My Sugar Mommy
paragraphs: "Looking at all these rewards, it makes me feel like the universe is my sugar mommy," Kent smiled as he took a rectangular-shaped item from his tower storage.
⟪Name: Tower City (Your Dream City)⟫
→ Build your dream city by designing and bringing it all together using this device.
→ All you need to do is think of what you want to add, and when everything is done, the Tower will take care of the rest for free.
→ Note: More than one person can work on designing the City, so get creative and find creative minds.

The last time he asked about the budget for Tower City, she mentioned billions. Now, he gets to have it for free, and the best part is he wouldn’t have to design it alone; he and his ladies can do it together.
This means that if he were to bring the beauty of Earth to the Tower, he could let his ladies also bring their imagination, and together, they would build a functioning city.
"Gaia is going to cry bitter tears," Kent smiled before taking the next item.

"I only have a B-ranked Dungeon Seeker Card that has a Peak Root Great Sage as the last floor boss. Now, I can upgrade the Seeker Card to the A-rank and will have a Peak Transcendent as the last floor boss.
I guess I’ll do that now."
Kent retrieved the card and channelled his energy into it. Right when he did that, a pop-up appeared before his eyes.
⟪Do you want to upgrade the B-Rank Dungeon Seeker Card or the S-rank Dungeon Seeker Card?⟫
"B-Rank."
The B-rank has ten different dungeons he can visit, unlike the S-rank, which only allows him to enter a single dungeon.
This means he will be getting the option to enter 12 A-rank dungeons, which, from what he knew, will get him close to 6 Dungeon bosses.
He already has 6 dungeon master tokens he can use to claim the dungeons after using them.
⟪Congratulations, you have upgraded your Dungeon Seeker Card from B-rank to A-rank.⟫
Kent smiled, looking at the message. He had already seen what Transcendents can do, so having 10 on speed dial would come in handy.
"Or maybe I should just clear the S-rank dungeon instead. That will give me an Ascension stage expert as the last floor boss," Kent thought.

"But from what Gaia said, dungeons grow increasingly dangerous as their ranks increase, so I cannot underestimate these dungeons. I must tread carefully if I want to gather more bodies for powerful undead later."
After checking everything, he was left with the memory key. He retrieved it, and for a moment, he wanted to use it, but then he knew things would change after leaving the memory, so he relaxed.
He still had the Sword Bridge to challenge, and winning that with memories from his past would be a cheat.
He had already failed once; he wouldn’t want to win it now, knowing it was because of his past memories influencing him.
"Aside from this, I still have two more on the way. I must relax and challenge the Sword Bridge first since I have progressed by leaps and bounds this past time before the battle with the evil sect.
I wouldn’t be happy knowing I won only because of Jest. Though he was me, I still need to make my own achievements even if he helped a little."
"On the other hand," he grinned as he exited the tower, appearing atop the mountain Kaizo had taken him to 15 days ago.
The moment he appeared, he noticed the disturbances in the space around him. They looked worn out, so from the look of things, they were left by those who came after him and Kaizo 15 days ago.
"They never learn," Kent smirked.
He sat down and closed his eyes. Then, using the connection between him and the shadow spider, he linked to it. It’s hidden inside the shadow of Bright Faywood.

"Tsk, he even has the audacity to be getting a massage at this time of day," Kent, who now had the eyes of the shadow spider, could see someone massaging the shoulders of that family head who was about to die.
"On the other hand, dying after such a pleasant massage wouldn’t be bad for him," he smiled and started to wait.
Two hours later, Bright Faywood entered a small room and sat in a chair. After a while, he picked up a crystal and spoke into it.
"Gandh, what is the progress on tracking down that brat?" he asked, and a voice spoke from the other end.

"We are currently hiding near the Divine Palace Sect with a few spies already inside. We have also bribed some elders within the sect, so we are on track to getting him the moment he appears again inside the sect.
Of course, right now, more than 15 families are after him. I’ve even heard some ancestors from some of the Noble Families are after him now.
Getting their hands on those battle dolls is a must. But aside from getting the battle dolls, they have even made provisions to capture him alive and enslave him.
But we won’t allow them."
"Alright. Keep me updated, and if anything goes wrong, don’t forget to use the token to call our allies. They are also keeping tabs on him, and it will be best if we gain more favor from them."
"I will, my lord."
Bright set the communication crystal down and sighed. He looked out the window and smiled.
"Soon"
"The moment I get my hands on that doll, I will visit that place and mine that ore," he grinned.
"The brat thought a fist-sized meteor could rival the one I have. Haha, I will show this whole world after I use the ore to upgrade those dolls that my Faywood Noble Family is not to be trifled with.
Our history is long, so I know how best to bring out the full potential of those dolls. The moment I get my hands on them, I will become the man."
His laughter grew as he rubbed his palms together like a thief staring at a treasure chest.
Kent, who saw and heard everything, smiled. "Too bad you’ll be dying before that. But thanks—after your death, I’ll know where this ore is and how to get it."
He looked at the grinning man and gave the order.
Suddenly, the smile froze on Bright’s face as something pointy stabbed him through the heart.
Just like that, one of the ancient families on the human continent lost its head, and all his secrets became Kent’s.
